Private Sub Workbook_BeforeClose(Cancel As Boolean)
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("Data").Delete
Sheets("Base").Delete
On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Sub DBOEE()

Dim nameFile As String
Dim SourceWb As Workbook
Dim actWB As Workbook
Dim lastsheet As Integer

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("DS").Delete
Sheets("NS").Delete
Sheets("Hourly_DS").Delete
Sheets("Hourly_NS").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Set actWB = ActiveWorkbook
lastsheet = actWB.Sheets.Count
nameFile = Application.GetOpenFilename()

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "DS"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "NS"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80


On Error Resume Next
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False
Set SourceWb = Workbooks.Open(FileName:=nameFile, ReadOnly:=False)
Application.DisplayAlerts = True
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = True
On Error GoTo 0
If SourceWb Is Nothing Then
Exit Sub
Else
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    SourceWb.Sheets("DS").Cells.Copy
    actWB.Worksheets("DS").Cells.PasteSpecial Paste:=xlPasteValues

    SourceWb.Sheets("NS").Cells.Copy
    actWB.Worksheets("NS").Cells.PasteSpecial Paste:=xlPasteValues

    SourceWb.Sheets("Hourly_DS").Copy After:=actWB.Sheets(lastsheet)
    SourceWb.Sheets("Hourly_NS").Copy After:=actWB.Sheets(lastsheet)
    
    actWB.Sheets("DS").AutoFilterMode = False
    actWB.Sheets("NS").AutoFilterMode = False
    actWB.Sheets("Hourly_DS").AutoFilterMode = False
    actWB.Sheets("Hourly_NS").AutoFilterMode = False
    
    actWB.Sheets("DS").Visible = True
    actWB.Sheets("NS").Visible = True
    actWB.Sheets("Hourly_DS").Visible = True
    actWB.Sheets("Hourly_NS").Visible = True
    
     SourceWb.Close

    
   


End If
RitageDS
End Sub

            End If
       Next i

      Application.CutCopyMode = False
End With

End With

    Next i

.Range("O1").value = "destination"
.Range("P1").value = "pile_id"

 For i = lastRowSummaryDS To 2 Step -1

            .Cells(i, 13).EntireRow.Delete
        End If
    Next i

.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit

VBA MACRO delay_db.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/delay_db'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Sub dbDElay(control As IRibbonControl)

Dim objWB As Workbook, SourcePath As String, wbName As String
SourcePath = File_Path

 Application.DisplayAlerts = False
 On Error Resume Next
    Sheets(1).Delete
    On Error GoTo 0

   Sheets.Add before:=Sheets(1)
    Sheets(1).Name = "DB"
    ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80
    'cek_expired
    Sheets(1).Select
    
Set New_Workbook = ThisWorkbook


    
    
Set File_Dialog = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFolderPicker)
File_Dialog.AllowMultiSelect = False
File_Dialog.Title = "Select the Excel Files"
If File_Dialog.Show <> -1 Then
Exit Sub
End If

File_Path = File_Dialog.SelectedItems(1) & "\"
File_Name = Dir(File_Path & "*.xlsx*")

'Path = File_Path & "*.xlsx"
' Filename = Dir(Path)
'    Do While Filename <> ""
'        Count = Count + 1
'        Filename = Dir()
'    Loop
'ChDir File_Path
'
'wbName = Dir("*.xlsx*")


With Application
.ScreenUpdating = False
.EnableEvents = False
.DisplayAlerts = False
.AskToUpdateLinks = False

'Open
Do While File_Name <> ""


Set file = Workbooks.Open(FileName:=File_Path & File_Name)

lastrowsource = file.Worksheets(1).Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
Set WorkRng = file.Worksheets(1).Range("A3:G" & lastrowsource)


'Date
For i = lastrowsource To 8 Step -1

    Cells(i, 8).value = Cells(3, 2).value

Next
'delete hidden rows

For i = lastrowsource To 1 Step -1

If Rows(i).Hidden = True Then Rows(i).EntireRow.Delete

Next

For Each rng In WorkRng
    If rng.MergeCells Then
        With rng.MergeArea
            .UnMerge
            .Formula = rng.Formula
        End With
    End If
Next
Application.DisplayAlerts = False





'file.Worksheets(1).Range("A3:G" & lastrowsource).UnMerge
file.Worksheets(1).Range("A3:H" & lastrowsource).Copy

lastrowTarget = New_Workbook.Worksheets(1).Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
New_Workbook.Worksheets(1).Cells(lastrowTarget, 1).PasteSpecial Paste:=xlPasteValues
file.Close SaveChanges:=False
File_Name = Dir


Loop

'Close
.AskToUpdateLinks = True
.DisplayAlerts = True
.EnableEvents = True
.ScreenUpdating = True
End With



Set New_Workbook = ThisWorkbook
'====================================Summary
lastrowSummary = New_Workbook.Worksheets(1).Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
lastrowCode = New_Workbook.Worksheets(1).Range("J" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row




With New_Workbook.Worksheets(1)
lastrowCode = New_Workbook.Worksheets(1).Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
'delete total
For i = lastrowSummary To 2 Step -1
    If .Cells(i, 3).value = "Total Standby & Delay :" Then
        .Cells(i, 3).EntireRow.Delete
    End If
Next i

'delete kosong
For i = lastrowSummary To 2 Step -1
    If .Cells(i, 3).value = "" Then
        .Cells(i, 3).EntireRow.Delete
    End If
Next i


.Range("C2:D" & lastrowCode).NumberFormat = "h:mm"
.Range("E2:E" & lastrowCode).NumberFormat = "0.00"

For i = lastrowSummary To 2 Step -1
    If Sheets(1).Cells(i, 2) = "Unit" Then
        Sheets(1).Cells(i, 2).EntireRow.Delete
    End If
Next i

.Range("A1") = "DATE"
.Range("B1") = "EXCAVATOR"
.Range("C1") = "TIE START"
.Range("D1") = "TIME FINISH"
.Range("E1") = "TOTAL HOURS"
.Range("F1") = "CODE"



For i = lastrowSummary To 2 Step -1
    .Cells(i, 1).value = .Cells(i, 8).value
Next i

.Range("A1:A" & lastrowCode).NumberFormat = "dd-mmm-yyyy"

.Columns("H:H").EntireColumn.Delete

.Range("A1:F" & lastrowCode).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
.Range("A1:G" & lastrowCode).Columns.AutoFit


On Error Resume Next
 With Range("B1", Range("B" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp))
      .SpecialCells(xlBlanks).FormulaR1C1 = "=R[1]C"
      .value = .value
   End With
   
   
'For i = 2 To lastrowCode
'        .Cells(i, 11).FormulaR1C1 = "=SUMIF(R1C6:R" & lastrowSummary & "C6,RC[-1],R1C5:R" & lastrowSummary & "C5)"
'7
'Next i
'
'
' ActiveSheet.AutoFilterMode = False
'With .Range("A1:F" & lastrowCode)
'
'    .AutoFilter field:=4, Criteria1:="", Operator:=xlFilterValues, field:=6, Criteria1:=""
'
'
'End With
 
 
lastrowFinal = New_Workbook.Worksheets(1).Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
Range("A" & lastrowFinal & ":A" & lastrowFinal + 200).EntireRow.Delete
Range("A1:G" & lastrowCode).Columns.AutoFit
End With

End Sub

VBA MACRO db_summary.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/db_summary'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Sub SumDelay(control As IRibbonControl)
 Application.DisplayAlerts = False
 On Error Resume Next
    Sheets("Delay").Delete
    On Error GoTo 0

   Sheets.Add After:=Sheets("DB")
    Sheets(2).Name = "Delay"
    ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80
    'cek_expired
    Sheets("Delay").Select

With Sheets("Delay")
    lastrowDB = Sheets(1).Range("A" & Sheets(1).Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    
    .Cells(3, 2).value = "Start Date"
    .Cells(4, 2).value = "End Date"
    .Cells(5, 2).value = "Total Hari"
    
    .Cells(3, 3).FormulaR1C1 = "=DB!R2C1"
    .Cells(4, 3).value = "=DB!R" & lastrowDB & "C1"
    
    .Cells(3, 3).Value2 = .Cells(3, 3).Value2
    .Cells(4, 3).Value2 = .Cells(4, 3).Value2
    .Cells(5, 3).Value2 = "=(R[-1]C-R[-2]C)+1"
    
    .Range("C3:C4").NumberFormat = "dd-mmm-yyyy"
    .Range("C3:C5").HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter

Public flname As String
Public SourceWb As Workbook

Sub DBOEE_gabung(control As IRibbonControl)

Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
Dim nameFile As String

Dim actWB As Workbook
Dim lastsheet As Integer
Dim SourceWb As Workbook

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("DS").Delete
Sheets("NS").Delete
Sheets("PBD").Delete
Sheets("Hourly_DS").Delete
Sheets("Hourly_NS").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Set actWB = ActiveWorkbook
lastsheet = actWB.Sheets.Count
nameFile = Application.GetOpenFilename()

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "DS"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "NS"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80


On Error Resume Next
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False
Set SourceWb = Workbooks.Open(FileName:=nameFile, ReadOnly:=False)
Application.DisplayAlerts = True
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = True
On Error GoTo 0
If SourceWb Is Nothing Then
Exit Sub
Else
Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    
    flname = SourceWb.Name
    
    SourceWb.Sheets("DS").Activate
    
    With ActiveWindow
    If .FreezePanes Then .FreezePanes = False
        .SplitColumn = 0
        .SplitRow = 1
        .FreezePanes = True
    End With
    
    If ActiveSheet.FilterMode = True Then
            ActiveSheet.ShowAllData
        End If
    
    SourceWb.Sheets("DS").Cells.Copy
    actWB.Worksheets("DS").Cells.PasteSpecial Paste:=xlPasteValues
    
    SourceWb.Sheets("NS").Activate
    
    With ActiveWindow
    If .FreezePanes Then .FreezePanes = False
        .SplitColumn = 0
        .SplitRow = 1
        .FreezePanes = True
    End With
    
    If ActiveSheet.FilterMode = True Then
            ActiveSheet.ShowAllData
        End If
    
    SourceWb.Sheets("NS").Cells.Copy
    actWB.Worksheets("NS").Cells.PasteSpecial Paste:=xlPasteValues

    SourceWb.Sheets("Hourly_DS").Copy After:=actWB.Sheets(lastsheet)
    SourceWb.Sheets("Hourly_NS").Copy After:=actWB.Sheets(lastsheet)
    
    actWB.Sheets("DS").AutoFilterMode = False
    actWB.Sheets("NS").AutoFilterMode = False
    actWB.Sheets("Hourly_DS").AutoFilterMode = False
    actWB.Sheets("Hourly_NS").AutoFilterMode = False
    
    actWB.Sheets("DS").Visible = True
    actWB.Sheets("NS").Visible = True
    actWB.Sheets("Hourly_DS").Visible = True
    actWB.Sheets("Hourly_NS").Visible = True
    
     SourceWb.Close

    
   


End If

'===================================================================== list unit
open_listunit_mining
'======================================================================
Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
RitageDS

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Sheets("listunit").Delete


End Sub

Function DoesSheetExists(sh As String) As Boolean
    Dim ws As Worksheet

    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(sh)
    On Error GoTo 0

    If Not ws Is Nothing Then DoesSheetExists = True
End Function



Function getTextBtwnNumbers(s As String) As String
    Dim pos1 As Long, pos2 As Long
    Dim i As Long, j As Long

    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        If pos1 = 0 Then
            Select Case Asc(Mid(s, i, 1))
            Case 65 To 90, 97 To 122
                pos1 = i
            End Select
        Else
            For j = pos1 To Len(s)
                Select Case Asc(Mid(s, j, 1))
                Case 65 To 90, 97 To 122
                Case Else
                    pos2 = j ' - 1
                    Exit For
                End Select
            Next j
        End If

        If pos1 <> 0 And pos2 <> 0 Then Exit For
    Next i

    If pos1 <> 0 And pos2 <> 0 Then
        getTextBtwnNumbers = Trim(Mid(s, pos1, pos2 - pos1))
    Else
        getTextBtwnNumbers = "Invalid Text Format"
    End If
End Function


Sub a()
 Dim flname As String
 
flname = ThisWorkbook.Name


    If getTextBtwnNumbers(flname) = "TOFU" Then
        MsgBox "Match Found"
    End If
End Sub


Public Function ContainsAny(ByVal string_source As String, ByVal caseSensitive As Boolean, ParamArray find_strings() As Variant) As Boolean

    Dim find As String, i As Integer, found As Boolean

    For i = LBound(find_strings) To UBound(find_strings)

        find = CStr(find_strings(i))
        found = Contains(string_source, find, caseSensitive)

        If found Then Exit For
    Next

    ContainsAny = found

End Function

   WorkSheetExistsHM = Not ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(strName) Is Nothing
End Function


Function SumSolver(Goal As Double, ListRange As Range)
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, Answer As Double, k As Long
    Dim rng As Variant
    Dim Answerlist As String, LastAdded As Long, AnswerListPos As String

    ' === Fix bug untuk single cell input ===
    If ListRange.Cells.Count = 1 Then
        ReDim rng(1 To 1)
        rng(1) = ListRange.value
    Else
        rng = Application.Transpose(ListRange)
    End If

    For i = 1 To UBound(rng)
        If rng(i) = Goal Then
            Answerlist = rng(i)
            GoTo SubExit
        ElseIf rng(i) < Goal Then
            Answer = rng(i)
            Answerlist = rng(i)
            AnswerListPos = i
            For j = i + 1 To UBound(rng)
                If Answer + rng(j) = Goal Then
                    Answerlist = Answerlist & "," & rng(j)
                    AnswerListPos = AnswerListPos & "," & j
                    GoTo SubExit
                ElseIf Answer + rng(j) < Goal Then
                    Answer = Answer + rng(j)
                    LastAdded = j
                    If Answerlist = "" Then
                        Answerlist = rng(j)
                        AnswerListPos = j
                    Else
                        Answerlist = Answerlist & "," & rng(j)
                        AnswerListPos = AnswerListPos & "," & j
                    End If
                End If
                If j = UBound(rng) Then
                    If LastAdded = UBound(rng) Then
                        Answerlist = Left(Answerlist, InStrRev(Answerlist, ",") - 1)
                        AnswerListPos = Left(AnswerListPos, InStrRev(AnswerListPos, ",") - 1)
                        Answer = Answer - rng(j)
                        LastAdded = val(Mid(AnswerListPos, InStrRev(AnswerListPos, ",") + 1))
                    End If
                    If LastAdded > 0 Then Answer = Answer - rng(LastAdded)
                    If InStr(Answerlist, ",") = 0 Then Exit For
                    j = val(Mid(AnswerListPos, InStrRev(AnswerListPos, ",") + 1))
                    Answerlist = Left(Answerlist, InStrRev(Answerlist, ",") - 1)
                    AnswerListPos = Left(AnswerListPos, InStrRev(AnswerListPos, ",") - 1)
                End If
            Next j
        End If
        Answerlist = ""
    Next i

SubExit:
    If Answerlist <> "" Then
        SumSolver = Answerlist
    Else
        SumSolver = "N/A"
    End If
End Function





Function IsFormula(c)
  IsFormula = True
  On Error Resume Next
  If Left(c.Formula, 1) = "=" Then IsFormula = True Else IsFormula = False
End Function

' Overview
'
' The goal in creating this form was first and foremost to overcome the monstrosity that
' is the Microsoft MonthView control. If you're reading this, you probably already know
' what I'm talking about. Many others have been in my place and have come up with their
' own date pickers to solve this problem. So why yet another custom date picker?
'
' I was most interested in the following features:
'   -Ease of use. I wanted a completely self-contained form that could be imported into
'       any VBA project and used without any additional coding.
'   -Simple, attractive design. While a lot of custom date pickers on the internet look
'       good and work well, none of them quite nailed it for me in terms of style and
'       UI design.
'   -Fully customizable functionality and look. I tried to include as many of the
'       options from the MonthView control as I could, without getting too messy.
'
' Since none of the date pickers I have been able to find in all my searching have quite
' completed my checklist, here we are! Now my hope is that some other tired soul may
' also benefit from my labors.
'
' If you encounter any bugs, or have any great ideas or feature requests that could
' improve this bad boy, please send me an email.
'
' What's new in v1.5.2:
'   -Bug fix: Userform not sizing properly in Word 2013
'   -Bug fix: Minimum font size not being preserved correctly
'   -Bug fix: Replaced WorksheetFunction.Max with custom Max function for compatibility
'       with other Office programs
'
' (For a full changelog, known bugs, and future enhancements, scroll to the bottom)
'''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''
