                    lMulai = i + 1
                    For r = startLoop To endloop
                        If myArray(x) = Sheets("SummaryDS").Cells(r, 4) Then
                            match = True
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    Next r
            
            If match = False Then
                ReDim Preserve unMatchedArray(n)
                unMatchedArray(n) = myArray(x)
                n = n + 1
            End If
            
            Next x
    n = n - 1

    If n > 0 Then
        s = endloop + 1
        y = 0

        For y = 0 To n
            Sheets("SummaryDS").Cells(s, 4) = unMatchedArray(y)
            s = s + 1
        Next y
    
    End If
End If
Erase unMatchedArray()
Next i
                  
End With

End Sub

Sub DS_finish()
With Sheets("SummaryDS")
    lastRowFinishing = .Cells(Sheets("SummaryDS").Rows.Count, 4).End(xlUp).Row
    For i = 2 To lastRowFinishing
        If .Cells(i, 4).value <> "" Then
            .Cells(i, 5).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-1]/24"
            .Cells(i, 6).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-1]+1/24"
            .Cells(i, 5).value = .Cells(i, 5).value
            .Cells(i, 6).value = .Cells(i, 6).value
        End If
        
        If .Cells(i, 1).value = "" Then
            .Cells(i, 1).FormulaR1C1 = "=R[-1]C"
            .Cells(i, 2).FormulaR1C1 = "=R[-1]C"
            .Cells(i, 3).FormulaR1C1 = "=R[-1]C"
            .Cells(i, 7).FormulaR1C1 = "=R[-1]C"
            .Cells(i, 8).FormulaR1C1 = "=R[-1]C"
            .Cells(i, 12).FormulaR1C1 = "=R[-1]C"
            .Cells(i, 13).FormulaR1C1 = "=R[-1]C"
            .Cells(i, 14).FormulaR1C1 = "=R[-1]C"
            .Cells(i, 15).FormulaR1C1 = "0"
            .Cells(i, 16).FormulaR1C1 = 0
            .Cells(i, 17).FormulaR1C1 = 0
            .Cells(i, 18).FormulaR1C1 = 0
        End If
    Next i
    
    .Range("I2:K" & lastRowFinishing).ClearContents
    
    For i = 2 To lastRowFinishing
        If .Cells(i, 4).value = "" Then
    
            .Range("A" & i & ":T" & i).ClearContents
    
            End If
     Next i
     
     .Range("D2:D" & lastRowFinishing).ClearContents
End With

End Sub

Sub Time()

With Sheets("Data")

'=================================================================== Awal Shift
lastRow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    For i = lastRow To 2 Step -1
        .Cells(i, 11).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(OR(RC[-4]=TIME(4,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(5,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(6,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(7,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(16,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(17,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(18,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(19,0,0)),""A"",""B"")"
        .Cells(i, 11).value = .Cells(i, 11).value
    Next

    For i = lastRow To 2 Step -1
        If .Cells(i, 11).value = "B" Then
            .Cells(i, 11).EntireRow.Insert
        End If
    Next
    
lastRow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
 For i = lastRow To 2 Step -1
        If .Cells(i, 1).value <> "" Then
        .Cells(i, 12).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(OR(RC[-4]=TIME(4,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(5,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(6,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(7,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(16,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(17,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(18,0,0),RC[-4]=TIME(19,0,0)),""C"",""D"")"
        '.Cells(i, 12).value = .Cells(i, 12).value
        End If
    Next
    
    For i = lastRow To 2 Step -1
        If .Cells(i, 12).value = "D" Then
            .Cells(i + 1, 12).EntireRow.Insert
        End If
    Next
    
lastRow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

    For i = lastRow To 2 Step -1
        If .Cells(i, 11).value = "B" And .Cells(i, 3).value = "1" Then
            .Cells(i, 8).Offset(-1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 7).value
            
             On Error Resume Next
             If .Cells(i, 4) = "MINING" Then
                .Cells(i, 7).Offset(-1, 0).value = TimeValue("07:00:00")
            Else
                .Cells(i, 7).Offset(-1, 0).value = TimeValue("05:00:00")
            End If
            
            ElseIf .Cells(i, 11).value = "B" And .Cells(i, 3).value = "2" Then
            .Cells(i, 8).Offset(-1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 7).value
            
             On Error Resume Next
             If .Cells(i, 4) = "MINING" Then
                .Cells(i, 7).Offset(-1, 0).value = TimeValue("19:00:00")
            Else
                .Cells(i, 7).Offset(-1, 0).value = TimeValue("17:00:00")
            End If
            
        End If
        
    Next
    
    
    For i = lastRow To 3 Step -1
         If .Cells(i, 11).value = "B" Then
        .Cells(i, 1).Offset(-1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 1).value
        .Cells(i, 2).Offset(-1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 2).value
        .Cells(i, 3).Offset(-1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 3).value
        .Cells(i, 4).Offset(-1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 4).value
        .Cells(i, 5).Offset(-1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 5).value
        .Cells(i, 6).Offset(-1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 6).value
        .Cells(i, 9).Offset(-1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 9).value
        .Cells(i, 10).Offset(-1, -1).value = "WH"
        End If

    Next i
    
   .Columns("K").ClearContents
'============================================================================================================================= end shift

lastRow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

    For i = lastRow To 2 Step -1
        If .Cells(i, 12).value = "D" And .Cells(i, 3).value = "1" Then
            .Cells(i, 7).Offset(1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 8).value
            
             On Error Resume Next
             If .Cells(i, 4) = "MINING" Then
                .Cells(i, 8).Offset(1, 0).value = TimeValue("19:00:00")
            Else
                .Cells(i, 8).Offset(1, 0).value = TimeValue("17:00:00")
            End If
            
            ElseIf .Cells(i, 12).value = "D" And .Cells(i, 3).value = "2" Then
            .Cells(i, 7).Offset(1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 8).value
            
             On Error Resume Next
             If .Cells(i, 4) = "MINING" Then
                .Cells(i, 8).Offset(1, 0).value = TimeValue("7:00:00")
            Else
                .Cells(i, 8).Offset(1, 0).value = TimeValue("5:00:00")
            End If
            
        End If
        
    Next

    For i = lastRow To 3 Step -1
         If .Cells(i, 12).value = "D" Then
        .Cells(i, 1).Offset(1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 1).value
        .Cells(i, 2).Offset(1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 2).value
        .Cells(i, 3).Offset(1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 3).value
        .Cells(i, 4).Offset(1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 4).value
        .Cells(i, 5).Offset(1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 5).value
        .Cells(i, 6).Offset(1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 6).value
        .Cells(i, 9).Offset(1, 0).value = .Cells(i, 9).value
        .Cells(i, 10).Offset(1, -1).value = "WH"
        End If

    Next i
    
     .Columns("L").ClearContents
    
End With

 End Sub

VBA MACRO pdb_rev_ver100224.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/pdb_rev_ver100224'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Sub rev_ver3_ds()

With Sheets("SummaryDS")
lastRow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
Dim FirstADT As Long
Dim lastADT As Long

FirstADT = Application.WorksheetFunction.match("Hauling", Sheets("listunit").Columns(1), 0)
lastADT = Sheets("listunit").Range("A:A").find(What:="Hauling", MatchCase:=True, _
            LookIn:=xlValues, _
            LookAt:=xlWhole, _
            SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, _
            After:=Sheets("listunit").Range("A1"), searchdirection:=xlPrevious).Row
            
            
Sheets("listunit").Range("B" & FirstADT & ":B" & lastADT).Copy .Range("M" & lastRow + 1)
Dim a As Integer
a = lastADT - FirstADT

'filter unit base on Pit ==================================================================
    
Sheets("listunit").Range("G" & FirstADT & ":G" & lastADT).Copy .Range("N" & lastRow + 1)



For i = lastRow + a + 1 To lastRow + 1 Step -1


Dim namaFile As String
namaFile = flname
Searchtext = "TOFU"

    If flname Like "*" & Searchtext & "*" Then
    
    If .Cells(i, 14).value = "KR" Then
        .Cells(i, 14).EntireRow.Delete
    End If
    
    Else
    
    If .Cells(i, 14).value = "TF" Then
        .Cells(i, 14).EntireRow.Delete
    End If
    
    End If
Next i
'==========================================================================================

Dim lastrowBD As Long

lastrowBD = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "M").End(xlUp).Row

For i = lastRow + 1 To lastrowBD
    .Cells(i, 14).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFERROR(MATCH(RC[-1],R2C13:R" & lastRow & "C13,0),""BD"")"
Next i

For i = lastrowBD To lastRow + 1 Step -1
    If .Cells(i, 14).value <> "BD" Then
        .Cells(i, 14).EntireRow.Delete
    End If
Next i


lastrowBD = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "M").End(xlUp).Row

For i = lastRow + 1 To lastrowBD
    .Cells(i, 14).FormulaR1C1 = "=VLOOKUP(RC[-1],listunit!R" & FirstADT & "C2:R" & lastADT & "C6,5,0)"
Next i

.Range("O" & lastRow + 1 & ":R" & lastrowBD).value = 0
.Range("N" & lastRow + 1 & ":N" & lastrowBD).value = .Range("N" & lastRow + 1 & ":N" & lastrowBD).value

.Range("L" & lastRow + 1 & ":L" & lastrowBD).value = .Range("L" & lastRow).value

.Range("A" & lastRow + 1 & ":A" & lastrowBD).value = .Range("A" & lastRow).value
.Range("B" & lastRow + 1 & ":B" & lastrowBD).value = .Range("B" & lastRow).value
.Range("C" & lastRow + 1 & ":C" & lastrowBD).value = .Range("C" & lastRow).value

.Range("G" & lastRow + 1 & ":G" & lastrowBD).value = .Range("G" & lastRow).value
.Range("H" & lastRow + 1 & ":H" & lastrowBD).value = .Range("H" & lastRow).value

'Start hour
.Range("E" & lastRow + 1 & ":E" & lastrowBD).value = 0.012152778 * 24
'End hour
.Range("F" & lastRow + 1 & ":F" & lastrowBD).value = 3.30105555555555E-02 * 24

.Columns("E:F").NumberFormat = "hh:mm"
.Columns("C").NumberFormat = "#"

End With
End Sub

Sub delay_digger()


Dim nameFile As String
Dim SourceWb As Workbook
Dim actWB As Workbook
Dim lastsheet As Integer

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("Report Delay DS").Delete
Sheets("Report Delay NS").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Set actWB = ActiveWorkbook
lastsheet = actWB.Sheets.Count
nameFile = Application.GetOpenFilename()

On Error Resume Next
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False

Set SourceWb = Workbooks.Open(FileName:=nameFile, ReadOnly:=False)

Application.DisplayAlerts = True
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = True
On Error GoTo 0
If SourceWb Is Nothing Then
Exit Sub
Else
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    SourceWb.Sheets("Report Delay DS").Visible = True
    SourceWb.Sheets("Report Delay NS").Visible = True
    
'    SourceWb.Sheets("Base").Cells.Copy
'    actWB.Worksheets("Data").Cells.PasteSpecial Paste:=xlPasteValues
    SourceWb.Sheets("Report Delay DS").Copy After:=actWB.Sheets(lastsheet)
    SourceWb.Sheets("Report Delay NS").Copy After:=actWB.Sheets(lastsheet)
    
'    actWB.Sheets("Breakdown Log").AutoFilterMode = False
'    actWB.Sheets("Breakdown Log").Visible = True

    
    SourceWb.Close
End If
delay_ds
End Sub


Sub delay_ds()


With Sheets("Report Delay DS")
lr = .Range("C" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
Set WorkRng = .Range("A3:G" & lr)

For i = lr To 1 Step -1

If .Rows(i).Hidden = True Then .Rows(i).EntireRow.Delete

Next



For Each rng In WorkRng
    If rng.MergeCells Then
        With rng.MergeArea
            .UnMerge
            .Formula = rng.Formula
        End With
    End If
Next
Application.DisplayAlerts = False

lastrowSummary = .Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
.Range("A6:G" & lastrowSummary).value = .Range("A6:G" & lastrowSummary).value
'delete total
For i = lastrowSummary To 2 Step -1
    If .Cells(i, 3).value = "Total Standby & Delay :" Then
        .Cells(i, 3).EntireRow.Delete
    End If
Next i

    .Range("I7").value = .Range("B3").value

'delete kosong
For i = lastrowSummary To 2 Step -1
    If .Cells(i, 3).value = "" Then
        .Cells(i, 3).EntireRow.Delete
    End If
Next i

'delete gambar
Dim shape As Excel.shape

For Each shape In .Shapes
        shape.Delete
Next

'delete keterangan
lastrowSummary = .Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
lastrowKeterangan = .Range("C" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row

.Range("A" & lastrowSummary + 1 & ":J" & lastrowKeterangan).Delete

'delete header
.Cells(2, 1).EntireRow.Delete
.Cells(1, 1).EntireRow.Delete

'unhidden column
.Range("H:Q").EntireColumn.Hidden = False
.Range("H:Q").ColumnWidth = 14

lastrowCode = .Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
lastListUnit = Sheets("listUnit").Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row

.Range("C2:D" & lastrowCode).NumberFormat = "h:mm"
.Range("E2:E" & lastrowCode).NumberFormat = "0.00"


Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
'============================================================================================ format Input OEE
.Range("I2:I" & lastrowCode).value = .Range("I1").value
.Range("J2:J" & lastrowCode).value = "SMA"
.Range("K2:K" & lastrowCode).value = "1"
.Range("L2:L" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=VLOOKUP(RC[-10],listUnit!R2C3:R" & lastListUnit & "C5,3,FALSE)"
.Range("M2:M" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=VLOOKUP(RC[1],listUnit!R2C3:R" & lastListUnit & "C7,5,FALSE)"
.Range("N2:N" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-12]"
.Range("O2:O" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-12]"
.Range("P2:P" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-12]"
.Range("Q2:Q" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(RC[-11]=""BBR"",""UNSCH"",IF(RC[-11]=""BPM"",""SCH"",IF(LEFT(RC[-11],1)=""R"",""WH"",IF(LEFT(RC[-11],1)=""D"",""STBY"",IF(LEFT(RC[-11],1)=""S"",""STBY"")))))"
.Range("R2:R" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-12]"

.Range("I2:R" & lastrowCode).value = .Range("I2:R" & lastrowCode).value

.Range("I1") = "Date"
.Range("J1") = "contractor"
.Range("K1") = "shift"
.Range("L1") = "activity"
.Range("M1") = "pit"
.Range("N1") = "unitID"
.Range("O1") = "startHour"
.Range("P1") = "endHour"
.Range("Q1") = "status"
.Range("R1") = "downtime code (WBN)"

.Range("I1:R1").Font.Bold = True
.Range("A1:R" & lastrowCode).Interior.ColorIndex = 2
.Range("I1:R" & lastrowCode).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter

 What:=" ", Replacement:="-", _
 SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True

End With
delay_NS

Sub delay_NS()


With Sheets("Report Delay NS")
lr = .Range("C" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
Set WorkRng = .Range("A3:G" & lr)

For i = lr To 1 Step -1

If .Rows(i).Hidden = True Then .Rows(i).EntireRow.Delete

Next



For Each rng In WorkRng
    If rng.MergeCells Then
        With rng.MergeArea
            .UnMerge
            .Formula = rng.Formula
        End With
    End If
Next
Application.DisplayAlerts = False

lastrowSummary = .Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
.Range("A6:G" & lastrowSummary).value = .Range("A6:G" & lastrowSummary).value
'delete total
For i = lastrowSummary To 2 Step -1
    If .Cells(i, 3).value = "Total Standby & Delay :" Then
        .Cells(i, 3).EntireRow.Delete
    End If
Next i

    .Range("I7").value = .Range("B3").value

'delete kosong
For i = lastrowSummary To 2 Step -1
    If .Cells(i, 3).value = "" Then
        .Cells(i, 3).EntireRow.Delete
    End If
Next i

'delete gambar
Dim shape As Excel.shape

For Each shape In .Shapes
        shape.Delete
Next

'delete keterangan
lastrowSummary = .Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
lastrowKeterangan = .Range("C" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row

.Range("A" & lastrowSummary + 1 & ":J" & lastrowKeterangan).Delete

'delete header
.Cells(2, 1).EntireRow.Delete
.Cells(1, 1).EntireRow.Delete

'unhidden column
.Range("H:Q").EntireColumn.Hidden = False
.Range("H:Q").ColumnWidth = 14

lastrowCode = .Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
lastListUnit = Sheets("listUnit").Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
.Range("C2:D" & lastrowCode).NumberFormat = "h:mm"
.Range("E2:E" & lastrowCode).NumberFormat = "0.00"

'============================================================================================ format Input OEE
.Range("I2:I" & lastrowCode).value = .Range("I1").value
.Range("J2:J" & lastrowCode).value = "SMA"
.Range("K2:K" & lastrowCode).value = "2"
.Range("L2:L" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=VLOOKUP(RC[-10],listUnit!R2C3:R" & lastListUnit & "C5,3,FALSE)"
.Range("M2:M" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=VLOOKUP(RC[1],listUnit!R2C3:R" & lastListUnit & "C7,5,FALSE)"
.Range("N2:N" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-12]"
.Range("O2:O" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-12]"
.Range("P2:P" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-12]"
.Range("Q2:Q" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(RC[-11]=""BBR"",""UNSCH"",IF(RC[-11]=""BPM"",""SCH"",IF(LEFT(RC[-11],1)=""R"",""WH"",IF(LEFT(RC[-11],1)=""D"",""STBY"",IF(LEFT(RC[-11],1)=""S"",""STBY"")))))"
.Range("R2:R" & lastrowCode).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-12]"

.Range("I2:R" & lastrowCode).value = .Range("I2:R" & lastrowCode).value

.Range("I1") = "Date"
.Range("J1") = "contractor"
.Range("K1") = "shift"
.Range("L1") = "activity"
.Range("M1") = "pit"
.Range("N1") = "unitID"
.Range("O1") = "startHour"
.Range("P1") = "endHour"
.Range("Q1") = "status"
.Range("R1") = "downtime code (WBN)"

.Range("I1:R1").Font.Bold = True
.Range("A1:R" & lastrowCode).Interior.ColorIndex = 2
.Range("I1:R" & lastrowCode).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter

.Range("N2:N" & lastrowCode).Replace _
 What:=" ", Replacement:="-", _
 SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True

End With

End Sub


Sub replaceDelayCOde()
    Dim fromList() As Variant
    Dim toList() As Variant
    
    fromList = Array("RLD", "RDW", "RRM", "RWM", "RPM", "DEH", "DWD", "DRF", "DRM", "DCA", "DRE", "DWT", "DBR", "SWR", "SCR", "SSP", "SSM", "SMB", "SHM", "SOP", "SDP", "SWM", "SFM", "SMS", "SPH", "SRE", "SWB", "SOR", "SWF", "SWL", "SWS", "SPC", "SMI", "SNJ", "SSC", "SWT", "SEF", "SNO", "SNS", "SCO", "SCU", "SAE", "SNL", "SND", "SNR", "SPD", "SRL", "BPM", "BBR")
    toList = Array("", "", "", "", "", "S12", "S12", "S11", "S20", "S20", "S20", "S16", "S18", "S1", "S2", "S18", "S20", "S5", "S6", "S10", "S9", "S19", "S9", "S19", "S8", "S15", "S18", "S17", "S15", "S13", "S12", "S20", "S4", "S13", "S6", "S12", "S7", "S13", "S13", "S6", "S14", "S13", "S13", "S13", "S13", "S19", "S17", "PM", "OTH")
        
    Dim i As Long
    For i = LBound(fromList) To UBound(fromList)
        Worksheets("Data").Columns("J").Replace _
            What:=fromList(i), Replacement:=toList(i), _
            SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, MatchCase:=True
    Next

End Sub

VBA MACRO pdb_rev_style_ver100224.bas

Sub revisi_style_pdb()

Dim lastRow As Long
Dim i As Integer
'Revisi Flo
With Sheets("SummaryDS")
lastRow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

    'start hour
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If .Cells(i, 5).value <> "" Then
            .Cells(i, 4).value = Format(.Cells(i, 5).value * 24, "##")
            .Cells(i, 4).value = .Cells(i, 4).value

        End If
    Next i

    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If .Cells(i, 5).value <> "" Then
            .Cells(i, 5).value = "=TEXT(RC[-1],""00"")"
            .Cells(i, 5).NumberFormat = "##"

        End If
    Next i

   
    .Range("E2:E" & lastRow).Copy
    .Range("E2:E" & lastRow).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
     .Range("D2:D" & lastRow).ClearContents
    'end hour

      For i = 2 To lastRow
        If .Cells(i, 5).value <> "" Then
            .Cells(i, 4).value = Format(.Cells(i, 6).value * 24, "##")
            .Cells(i, 4).value = .Cells(i, 4).value

        End If
    Next i

    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If .Cells(i, 5).value <> "" Then
            .Cells(i, 6).value = "=TEXT(RC[-2],""00"")"
            .Cells(i, 6).NumberFormat = "##"

        End If
    Next i

  .Range("F2:F" & lastRow).Copy
    .Range("F2:F" & lastRow).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
     .Range("D2:D" & lastRow).ClearContents
    'Time Group

    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If .Cells(i, 5).value <> "" Then
            .Cells(i, 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=CONCATENATE(RC[1],""-"",RC[2])"
        End If
    Next i
    .Range("D2:D" & lastRow).Copy
    .Range("D2").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
    .Range("D2:D" & lastRow).NumberFormat = "General"
    'no space

    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If .Cells(i, 5).value <> "" Then
            .Cells(i, 9).FormulaR1C1 = "=SUBSTITUTE(RC[-1],"" "","""")"
            .Cells(i, 8).value = .Cells(i, 9).value
        End If
    Next i
    .Range("I2:I" & lastRow).ClearContents

    .Columns("K").Delete


End With




With Sheets("SummaryNS")
lastRow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

    'start hour

    Next i
    
    .Range("E2:E" & lastRow).Copy

     .Range("D2:D" & lastRow).ClearContents
    'end hour
    
      For i = 2 To lastRow
        If .Cells(i, 5).value <> "" Then
            .Cells(i, 4).value = Format(.Cells(i, 6).value * 24, "##")

     .Range("D2:D" & lastRow).ClearContents
    
  
'replace 24 jadi 0

        End If
    Next i
    

     For i = 2 To lastRow

        End If

VBA MACRO audb_mining_delay_delete_audb.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/audb_mining_delay_delete_audb'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Sub insert_delay()
lastData = Sheets("Data").Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
lastDelayDS = Sheets("Report Delay DS").Range("I" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
lastDelayNS = Sheets("Report Delay NS").Range("I" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row

'Delay
Sheets("Report Delay DS").Range("H2:H" & lastDelayDS).FormulaR1C1 = "=CONCATENATE(RC[3],RC[6])"
Sheets("Report Delay NS").Range("H2:H" & lastDelayNS).FormulaR1C1 = "=CONCATENATE(RC[3],RC[6])"
Sheets("Report Delay DS").Range("H2:H" & lastDelayDS).value = Sheets("Report Delay DS").Range("H2:H" & lastDelayDS).value
Sheets("Report Delay NS").Range("H2:H" & lastDelayNS).value = Sheets("Report Delay NS").Range("H2:H" & lastDelayNS).value

'Data
Sheets("Data").Range("K2:K" & lastData).FormulaR1C1 = "=CONCATENATE(RC[-8],RC[-5])"
Sheets("Data").Range("K2:K" & lastData).value = Sheets("Data").Range("K2:K" & lastData).value


For i = lastData To 2 Step -1
    For j = lastDelayDS To 2 Step -1
        'DS
        If Sheets("Data").Cells(i, 11).value = Sheets("Report Delay DS").Cells(j, 8).value Then
            Sheets("Data").Rows(i).Delete
        End If
    Next j
Next i

lastData = Sheets("Data").Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row

For i = lastData To 2 Step -1
    For j = lastDelayNS To 2 Step -1
        'NS
        If Sheets("Data").Cells(i, 11).value = Sheets("Report Delay NS").Cells(j, 8).value Then
            Sheets("Data").Rows(i).Delete
        End If
    Next j
Next i
'clean

Sheets("Data").Range("K2:K" & lastData).ClearContents
Sheets("Report Delay DS").Range("H2:H" & lastDelayDS).ClearContents
Sheets("Report Delay NS").Range("H2:H" & lastDelayNS).ClearContents

lastData = Sheets("Data").Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row

'copas DS
Sheets("Report Delay DS").Range("I2:R" & lastDelayDS).Copy Sheets("Data").Range("A" & lastData + 1)

lastData = Sheets("Data").Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
'copas NS
Sheets("Report Delay NS").Range("I2:R" & lastDelayNS).Copy Sheets("Data").Range("A" & lastData + 1)

lastData = Sheets("Data").Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
Sheets("Data").Range("A2:A" & lastData).NumberFormat = "dd-mm-yyyy"

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Sheets("Report Delay DS").Delete
Sheets("Report Delay NS").Delete
replaceDelayCOde

Application.DisplayAlerts = False

Sheets("listunit").Delete
Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
End Sub

Dim datavariable As Date

Sub uPtoAudb3()

Dim nameFile As String
Dim SourceWb As Workbook
Dim actWB As Workbook
Dim lastsheet As Integer
Dim path As String, file As String
 
 path = "P:\02.Share by ENGINEERING\OEE\OEE\"
 file = "Update_UP"

Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("BREAKDOWN").Delete
Sheets("Base").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Set actWB = ActiveWorkbook
lastsheet = actWB.Sheets.Count

If Dir(path & file & ".xlsx") <> "" Then
    
'===================================================== Unit Performance
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False

    Set SourceWb = Workbooks.Open(path & file & ".xlsx")

Else

MsgBox "Buka Unit Performace !"
nameFile = Application.GetOpenFilename()

On Error Resume Next
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False

Set SourceWb = Workbooks.Open(FileName:=nameFile, ReadOnly:=False)
End If

Application.DisplayAlerts = True
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = True
On Error GoTo 0
If SourceWb Is Nothing Then
Exit Sub
Else
Application.DisplayAlerts = False


    SourceWb.Sheets("Breakdown Log").Copy After:=actWB.Sheets(lastsheet)
    
    actWB.Sheets("Breakdown Log").AutoFilterMode = False
    actWB.Sheets("Breakdown Log").Visible = True
    
    SourceWb.Sheets("Base").Copy After:=actWB.Sheets(lastsheet)
    
    actWB.Sheets("Base").AutoFilterMode = False
    actWB.Sheets("Base").Visible = True

    
    SourceWb.Close
End If

End Sub

                 Sheets("WB").Range("T1:T" & lOperator).Copy
                .Range("C3").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
                
                'Date
                For i = 1 To DiffDate
                    .Cells(2, 5 + i).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-1]+1"
                Next i
                
                'count
                lTanggal = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
                For i = 1 To lTanggal - 4
                    For j = 1 To lOperator
                        .Cells(j + 2, i + 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(COUNTIFS(WB!C5,R" & 2 + j & "C3,WB!C2,R2C" & i + 4 & ")=0,"""",COUNTIFS(WB!C5,R" & 2 + j & "C3,WB!C2,R2C" & i + 4 & "))"
                    
                    Next j
                Next i
                
                For i = 3 To lOperator + 2
                    .Cells(i, 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=SUM(RC5:RC" & lTanggal & ")"
                Next i
                '.Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).value = .Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).value
                
             
          
            'merge
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lTanggal)).Merge
            
            
            'ORACLE
            For i = 3 To lOperator + 2
                
                .Cells(i, 2).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(INDEX(WB!R2C4:R" & lWb & "C4,MATCH(RC[1],WB!R2C5:R" & lWb & "C5,0))=0,"""",INDEX(WB!R2C4:R" & lWb & "C4,MATCH(RC[1],WB!R2C5:R" & lWb & "C5,0)))"
          
            Next i
            
           
             lOperator = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 3).End(xlUp).Row
            .Range("B3:C" & lOperator).value = .Range("B3:C" & lOperator).value
            
            .Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).Sort Key1:=.Range("D2"), Order1:=xlDescending, Header:=xlYes, _
            OrderCustom:=1, MatchCase:=False, Orientation:=xlTopToBottom, _
            DataOption1:=xlSortNormal
            
            'Index
           
            For i = 1 To lOperator - 2
                .Cells(2 + i, 1).FormulaR1C1 = i
            Next i
            
            lrSum = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
            lcSum = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
            .Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
            
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(3, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum))
                 With rng.Borders
                    .LineStyle = xlContinuous
                    .Color = vbBlack
                    .Weight = xlThin
                End With
            '============== Header tanggal
            With .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(2, lcSum))
                .Interior.Color = RGB(255, 217, 102)
                .NumberFormat = "d mmm"
                .Font.Bold = True
            End With
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(2, lcSum))
                 With rng.Borders
                    .LineStyle = xlContinuous
                    .Color = vbBlack
                    .Weight = xlThin
                End With
                
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(2, lcSum))
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeBottom)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeTop)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
        
            .Range("A" & lrSum + 1).value = "Total"
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum)).Font.Bold = True
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 4)).Font.Size = 14
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 3)).Merge
            
            For i = 1 To lTanggal - 3
                .Cells(lrSum + 1, i + 3).FormulaR1C1 = "=SUM(R3C" & 3 + i & ":R" & lrSum & "C" & 3 + i & ")"
            Next i
          
          Set rng = .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum))
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeBottom)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeTop)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            .UsedRange.value = .UsedRange.value
            
            '.Range("A2:A319" & lOperator + 1).AutoFilter , Field:=1, Criteria1:="<>"
            .UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
            .Activate
            
            Sheets("WB").Delete
            End With
           
      

Else
    Exit Sub
End If


Else

bd_engine_byDT

End If
End Sub

        Set activews = w.ActiveSheet
    End If

        wsv.sheet.Activate

last2 = SourceWb.Worksheets(2).Cells(SourceWb.Worksheets(3).Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
last3 = SourceWb.Worksheets(3).Cells(SourceWb.Worksheets(3).Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

SourceWb.Worksheets(2).Range("A2:C" & last2).Interior.Color = RGB(154, 0, 0)
SourceWb.Worksheets(3).Range("A2:C" & last3).Interior.Color = RGB(0, 154, 0)

SourceWb.Worksheets(1).Range("A" & last1 + 1).PasteSpecial xlValues
SourceWb.Worksheets(1).Range("A" & last1 + 1).PasteSpecial xlFormats

last1 = SourceWb.Worksheets(1).Cells(SourceWb.Worksheets(1).Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

SourceWb.Worksheets(3).Range("A2:C" & last2).Copy
SourceWb.Worksheets(1).Range("A" & last1 + 1).PasteSpecial xlValues
SourceWb.Worksheets(1).Range("A" & last1 + 1).PasteSpecial xlFormats

SourceWb.Worksheets(1).Name = "RR"

SourceWb.Worksheets(2).Delete

.Range("A1:A" & last1).Replace "SMAW", ""
.Range("B1:B" & last1).Replace "SMA", ""
End With

SourceWb.Sheets("RR").Copy After:=actWB.Sheets(actWB.Sheets.Count)

With Sheets("Daily")

lRR = Sheets("RR").Cells(Sheets("RR").Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    
For i = 2 To lDaily
    .Cells(i, 10).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFERROR(IFNA(INDEX(RR!R2C3:R" & lRR & "C3,MATCH(RC[-1],RR!R2C2:R" & lRR & "C2,0)),INDEX(RR!R2C3:R" & lRR & "C3,MATCH(RC[-1],RR!R2C1:R" & lRR & "C1,0))),"""")"
Next i

.Range("J2:J" & lDaily).value = .Range("J2:J" & lDaily).value
 For i = 2 To lDaily

Else
MsgBox "Buka Excel Master Breakdown"

With Sheets("HM")

    For i = x To y
        .Cells(i, 7).FormulaR1C1 = "=VLOOKUP(RC[-5],'HMdaily'!R4C2:R" & LastdailyHM & "C25,6,FALSE)"
        .Cells(i, 12).FormulaR1C1 = "=VLOOKUP(RC[-10],'HMdaily'!R4C2:R" & LastdailyHM & "C25,11,FALSE)"
        .Cells(i, 18).FormulaR1C1 = "=VLOOKUP(RC[-16],'HMdaily'!R4C2:R" & LastdailyHM & "C25,17,FALSE)"
    Next i
    
    .Range("G" & x & ":G" & y).value = .Range("W" & x & ":W" & y).value
    .Range("L" & x & ":L" & y).value = .Range("L" & x & ":L" & y).value
    .Range("R" & x & ":R" & y).value = .Range("R" & x & ":R" & y).value
    
    
    For i = x To y
        If Application.WorksheetFunction.IsNA(.Cells(i, 7)) Then
            .Cells(i, 7).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-1]"
        End If
    Next i

     .Range("L" & x & ":L" & y).Replace "#N/A", 0
     .Range("N" & x & ":N" & y).Replace "#N/A", 0
     .Range("R" & x & ":R" & y).Replace "#N/A", 0

End With

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Sheets("HMdaily").Delete

Else
MsgBox "Buka Excel HM Unit"
End If
End Sub

Sub bd_log_hauling(control As IRibbonControl)

Dim lastRowBreakdown As Long
Dim lastDataBreakDown As Long
Dim i As Long

On Error Resume Next

 For Z = 1 To Worksheets.Count
 
On Error Resume Next
        If Worksheets(Z).Name = "BD LOG" Then
            Exists = True
    
DateVariable = CalendarForm.getDate

Dim Ans 'Answer
Dim shift As String

Ans = MsgBox("Day Shift ?", vbYesNo)

If Ans = vbYes Then
    shift = "DS"
Else
    shift = "NS"
End If

Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("DataBreakDown").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "DataBreakDown"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80

'======================================================================================= Data Breakdown
With Sheets("BREAKDOWN")
.AutoFilterMode = False

lastDataBreakDown = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

With .Range("A1:M" & lastDataBreakDown)
    .AutoFilter , Field:=7, Criteria1:=Format(DateVariable, "d-mmm-yy")
    .AutoFilter , Field:=8, Criteria1:=shift
End With


lastRowBreakdown = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
.Range("C1:L1").UnMerge
.Range("C1:L" & lastRowBreakdown).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
Sheets("DataBreakDown").Range("A1").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
End With

With Sheets("DataBreakDown").Cells
    lastRowDataBreakdown = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    .Columns("E").NumberFormat = "dd-mmm-yy"
    .Columns("H:I").NumberFormat = "hh:mm"
    .Columns("C:C").Cut Destination:=.Columns("k:k")
    .Columns("B:C").EntireColumn.Delete
    
    If shift = "DS" Then
        For i = 2 To lastRowDataBreakdown
        
            If .Cells(i, 7).value = "" Then
             .Cells(i, 7).value = "19:00"
            End If
            .Cells(i, 5).value = "1"
        Next i
    ElseIf shift = "NS" Then
        For i = 2 To lastRowDataBreakdown
            If .Cells(i, 7).value = "" Then
             .Cells(i, 7).value = "07:00"
            End If
                    .Cells(i, 5).value = "2"
        Next i
    End If
    
    
    
    
    For i = 2 To lastRowDataBreakdown
        If .Cells(i, 9).value = "PM" Then
            .Cells(i, 4).value = "SCH"
        Else
            .Cells(i, 4).value = "UNSCH"
        End If
    Next i
    
 Dim lastGkrapi As Integer
 lastGkrapi = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "C").End(xlUp).Row
 
 '.Range("A" & lastRowDataBreakdown + 1 & ":I" & lastGkrapi).EntireRow.Delete
.EntireColumn.AutoFit
.Columns("H").Delete
End With

   End If
    Next Z
If Not Exists Then
    MsgBox "Buka Excel Daily WB"
    Exit Sub
End If

With Sheets("DataBreakDown")
.Columns(4).EntireColumn.Insert
.Columns(4).EntireColumn.Insert
.Columns(7).EntireColumn.Insert
.Columns(11).EntireColumn.Insert
.Columns(11).EntireColumn.Insert
.Columns(11).EntireColumn.Insert
.Columns(11).EntireColumn.Insert
.Columns(11).EntireColumn.Insert
End With

ActiveSheet.Name = "BD " & shift
End Sub


Sub bd_log_mdo(control As IRibbonControl)

Dim lastRowBreakdown As Long
Dim lastDataBreakDown As Long
Dim i As Long

On Error Resume Next

 For Z = 1 To Worksheets.Count
 
On Error Resume Next
        If Worksheets(Z).Name = "BD LOG" Then
            Exists = True
    
DateVariable = CalendarForm.getDate

Dim Ans 'Answer
Dim shift As String

Ans = MsgBox("Day Shift ?", vbYesNo)

If Ans = vbYes Then
    shift = "DS"
Else
    shift = "NS"
End If

Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("DataBreakDown").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "DataBreakDown"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80

'======================================================================================= Data Breakdown
open_listunit_mdo

With Sheets("BREAKDOWN")
.AutoFilterMode = False


'====== Array Unit MDO
Dim RngOne As Range, cell As Range
Dim LastCell As Long
Dim arrList() As String, lngCnt As Long

With Sheets("listunit")
    LastCell = .Range("A" & .Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    Set RngOne = .Range("A2:A" & LastCell)
End With

'load values into an array
lngCnt = 0
For Each cell In RngOne
    ReDim Preserve arrList(lngCnt)
    arrList(lngCnt) = cell.Text
    lngCnt = lngCnt + 1
Next


'======================

lastDataBreakDown = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

With .Range("A1:M" & lastDataBreakDown)
    .AutoFilter , Field:=7, Criteria1:=Format(DateVariable, "d-mmm-yy")
    .AutoFilter , Field:=8, Criteria1:=shift
    .AutoFilter , Field:=3, Criteria1:=arrList, Operator:=xlFilterValues
End With


lastRowBreakdown = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
.Range("C1:L1").UnMerge
.Range("C1:L" & lastRowBreakdown).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
Sheets("DataBreakDown").Range("A1").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
End With

With Sheets("DataBreakDown").Cells
    lastRowDataBreakdown = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    .Columns("E").NumberFormat = "dd-mmm-yy"
    .Columns("H:I").NumberFormat = "hh:mm"
    .Columns("C:C").Cut Destination:=.Columns("k:k")
    .Columns("B:C").EntireColumn.Delete
    
    If shift = "DS" Then
        For i = 2 To lastRowDataBreakdown
        
            If .Cells(i, 7).value = "" Then
             .Cells(i, 7).value = "19:00"
            End If
            .Cells(i, 5).value = "1"
        Next i
    ElseIf shift = "NS" Then
        For i = 2 To lastRowDataBreakdown
            If .Cells(i, 7).value = "" Then
             .Cells(i, 7).value = "07:00"
            End If
                    .Cells(i, 5).value = "2"
        Next i
    End If
    
    
    
    
    For i = 2 To lastRowDataBreakdown
        If .Cells(i, 9).value = "PM" Then
            .Cells(i, 4).value = "SCH"
        Else
            .Cells(i, 4).value = "UNSCH"
        End If
    Next i
    
 Dim lastGkrapi As Integer
 lastGkrapi = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "C").End(xlUp).Row
 
 '.Range("A" & lastRowDataBreakdown + 1 & ":I" & lastGkrapi).EntireRow.Delete
.EntireColumn.AutoFit
.Columns("H").Delete
End With

   End If
    Next Z
If Not Exists Then
    MsgBox "Buka Excel Daily WB"
    Exit Sub
End If

With Sheets("DataBreakDown")
.Columns(3).Cut
.Columns(1).EntireColumn.Insert

.Columns(5).Cut
.Columns(2).EntireColumn.Insert

.Columns(8).EntireColumn.Insert



End With
Sheets("DataBreakDown").Activate
ActiveSheet.Name = "BD " & shift
Sheets("listunit").Delete
End Sub

VBA MACRO TTM_run_unit.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/TTM_run_unit'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Sub run_adt40()

Dim lastBase As Long
Dim lastBudget As Long

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("proses").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "proses"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80


With Sheets("Base")

lastBase = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row


.AutoFilterMode = False
'===============================================ADT40 BUDGET
With .Range("A1:P" & lastBase)
    .AutoFilter , Field:=2, Criteria1:="ADT"
    .AutoFilter , Field:=5, Criteria1:="40"
    .AutoFilter , Field:=15, Criteria1:="BUDGET"
    
  .SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
Sheets("Proses").Range("A1").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
'===============================================ADT SPARE

    .AutoFilter , Field:=2, Criteria1:="ADT"
    .AutoFilter , Field:=5, Criteria1:="40"
    .AutoFilter , Field:=15, Criteria1:="SPARE"
    
  .SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
Sheets("Proses").Range("R1").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues

End With
.AutoFilterMode = False

End With

'======================================================================================== Report

Dim RFUadt40 As Integer
Dim contractAdt40 As Integer
Dim adt40BdBudget As Integer
Dim adt40RfuSpare As Integer
Dim adt40Bd As Integer
Dim lastAdt40tBudget As Integer
Dim lastAdt40Spare As Integer

RFUadt40 = Sheets("Contract").Range("E8").value

contractAdt40 = Sheets("Contract").Range("B8").value
adt40BdBudget = Sheets("Contract").Range("H8").value
adt40RfuSpare = Sheets("Contract").Range("J8").value


With Sheets("Proses")
lastAdt40tBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
lastAdt40Spare = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "R").End(xlUp).Row

'=========================================================================== Jika ADT40 Budget yang BD lebih besar dari ADT40 Spare yang ready

If adt40BdBudget <> 0 Then

If adt40BdBudget >= adt40RfuSpare Then

.Range("A1:P" & lastAdt40tBudget).Sort Key1:=.Range("P1:P" & lastAdt40tBudget), Order1:=xlAscending, Header:=xlYes

'Bersihkan ADT yang BD di Spare
For i = lastAdt40Spare To 2 Step -1
If .Cells(i, 33).value = "BD" Then
.Range(.Cells(i, 18), .Cells(i, 33)).Delete shift:=xlUp
End If
Next i

'Hapus BD di Budget berdasarkan jumlah RFU yang ada di spare
lastAdt40tBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
If lastAdt40Spare > 1 Then
.Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(adt40RfuSpare + 1, 16)).Delete shift:=xlUp

'Masukan ADT40 Spare ke list Budget
lastAdt40tBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
.Range(.Cells(2, 18), .Cells(adt40RfuSpare + 1, 33)).Copy
.Range("A" & lastAdt40tBudget + 1).PasteSpecial

lastAdt40tBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
'Buat Index

For i = 2 To lastAdt40tBudget
    .Cells(i, 1).value = i - 1
Next i
End If
Application.CutCopyMode = False

'===================================================================================== Jika ADT40 Budget yang BD lebih kecil dari ADT40 Spare yang ready

Else

.Range("A1:P" & lastAdt40tBudget).Sort Key1:=.Range("P1:P" & lastAdt40tBudget), Order1:=xlAscending, Header:=xlYes

'Bersihkan ADT yang BD di Spare
For i = lastAdt40Spare To 2 Step -1
If .Cells(i, 33).value = "BD" Then
.Range(.Cells(i, 18), .Cells(i, 33)).Delete shift:=xlUp
End If
Next i

'====================================================================================== Hapus BD di Budget berdasarkan jumlah BD di spare
If lastAdt40Spare > 1 Then
.Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(adt40BdBudget + 1, 16)).Delete shift:=xlUp

'Masukan ADT40 Spare ke list Budget
lastAdt40tBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
.Range(.Cells(2, 18), .Cells(adt40BdBudget + 1, 33)).Copy
.Range("A" & lastAdt40tBudget + 1).PasteSpecial

lastAdt40tBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row


'======================================================================= Buat Index
For i = 2 To lastAdt40tBudget
    .Cells(i, 1).value = i - 1
Next i
End If
Application.CutCopyMode = False

End If


Else

.Range("A1").Select

End If
End With

Dim lastBaseEq As Long
Dim LastProses As Long

lastBaseEq = Sheets("Base Eq").Cells(Sheets("Base Eq").Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
LastProses = Sheets("Proses").Cells(Sheets("Proses").Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row

Sheets("Proses").Range("A1:p" & LastProses).Copy
Sheets("Base Eq").Range("A" & lastBaseEq).PasteSpecial

Application.DisplayAlerts = False

Sheets("Base Eq").Select
ActiveSheet.Range("A1").Select
End Sub

End If
Next i

'Hapus BD di Budget berdasarkan jumlah RFU yang ada di spare
lastadt60Spare = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "R").End(xlUp).Row
If lastadt60Spare > 1 Then
.Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(adt60RfuSpare + 1, 16)).Delete shift:=xlUp

'Masukan adt60 Spare ke list Budget
lastadt60tBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
.Range(.Cells(2, 18), .Cells(adt60RfuSpare + 1, 33)).Copy
.Range("A" & lastadt60tBudget + 1).PasteSpecial

lastadt60tBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
'Buat Index

For i = 2 To lastadt60tBudget
    .Cells(i, 1).value = i - 1
Next i
End If
Application.CutCopyMode = False

'===================================================================================== Jika adt60 Budget yang BD lebih kecil dari adt60 Spare yang ready

Else

.Range("A1:P" & lastadt60tBudget).Sort Key1:=.Range("P1:P" & lastadt60tBudget), Order1:=xlAscending, Header:=xlYes

'Bersihkan ADT yang BD di Spare
For i = lastadt60Spare To 2 Step -1
If .Cells(i, 33).value = "BD" Then
.Range(.Cells(i, 18), .Cells(i, 33)).Delete shift:=xlUp
End If
Next i

'====================================================================================== Hapus BD di Budget berdasarkan jumlah BD di spare
If lastadt60Spare > 1 Then
.Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(adt60BdBudget + 1, 16)).Delete shift:=xlUp

'Masukan adt60 Spare ke list Budget
lastadt60tBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
.Range(.Cells(2, 18), .Cells(adt60BdBudget + 1, 33)).Copy
.Range("A" & lastadt60tBudget + 1).PasteSpecial

lastadt60tBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row


'======================================================================= Buat Index
For i = 2 To lastadt60tBudget
    .Cells(i, 1).value = i - 1
Next i
End If
Application.CutCopyMode = False

End If


Else

.Range("A1").Select

End If
End With

exc80RfuSpare = Sheets("Contract").Range("J3").value

lastexc80Spare = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "R").End(xlUp).Row

If exc80BdBudget >= exc80RfuSpare Then

.Range("A1:P" & lastexc80tBudget).Sort Key1:=.Range("P1:P" & lastexc80tBudget), Order1:=xlAscending, Header:=xlYes

End If
Next i

'Hapus BD di Budget berdasarkan jumlah RFU yang ada di spare

.Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(exc80RfuSpare + 1, 16)).Delete shift:=xlUp

'Masukan exc80 Spare ke list Budget

.Range("A" & lastexc80tBudget + 1).PasteSpecial

    .Cells(i, 1).value = i - 1
Next i

End If
Application.CutCopyMode = False

'===================================================================================== Jika exc80 Budget yang BD lebih kecil dari exc80 Spare yang ready

Else

.Range("A1:P" & lastexc80tBudget).Sort Key1:=.Range("P1:P" & lastexc80tBudget), Order1:=xlAscending, Header:=xlYes

Dim lastDTSpare As Integer




'-------------------------------------------------------- CONTRACT
contractDT = Sheets("Contract").Range("B15").value
DTBdBudget = Sheets("Contract").Range("H15").value
DTRfuSpare = Sheets("Contract").Range("J15").value
'------------------------------------------------------------------



With Sheets("Proses")
lastDTtBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
lastDTSpare = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "R").End(xlUp).Row

If DTBdBudget <> 0 Then
'=========================================================================== Jika DT Budget yang BD lebih besar dari DT Spare yang ready
If DTBdBudget >= DTRfuSpare Then

.Range("A1:P" & lastDTtBudget).Sort Key1:=.Range("P1:P" & lastDTtBudget), Order1:=xlAscending, Header:=xlYes

'Bersihkan ADT yang BD di Spare
For i = lastDTSpare To 2 Step -1
If .Cells(i, 33).value = "BD" Then
.Range(.Cells(i, 18), .Cells(i, 33)).Delete shift:=xlUp
End If
Next i

'Hapus BD di Budget berdasarkan jumlah RFU yang ada di spare
lastDTSpare = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "R").End(xlUp).Row
If lastDTSpare > 1 Then
.Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(DTRfuSpare + 1, 16)).Delete shift:=xlUp

'Masukan DT Spare ke list Budget
lastDTtBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
.Range(.Cells(2, 18), .Cells(DTRfuSpare + 1, 33)).Copy
.Range("A" & lastDTtBudget + 1).PasteSpecial

lastDTtBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
'Buat Index

For i = 2 To lastDTtBudget
    .Cells(i, 1).value = i - 1
Next i

End If
Application.CutCopyMode = False

'===================================================================================== Jika DT Budget yang BD lebih kecil dari DT Spare yang ready

Else

.Range("A1:P" & lastDTtBudget).Sort Key1:=.Range("P1:P" & lastDTtBudget), Order1:=xlAscending, Header:=xlYes

'Bersihkan ADT yang BD di Spare
For i = lastDTSpare To 2 Step -1
If .Cells(i, 33).value = "BD" Then
.Range(.Cells(i, 18), .Cells(i, 33)).Delete shift:=xlUp
End If
Next i

'====================================================================================== Hapus BD di Budget berdasarkan jumlah BD di spare
If lastDTSpare > 1 Then
.Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(DTBdBudget + 1, 16)).Delete shift:=xlUp

'Masukan DT Spare ke list Budget
lastDTtBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
.Range(.Cells(2, 18), .Cells(DTBdBudget + 1, 33)).Copy
.Range("A" & lastDTtBudget + 1).PasteSpecial

lastDTtBudget = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row


'======================================================================= Buat Index
For i = 2 To lastDTtBudget
    .Cells(i, 1).value = i - 1
Next i
End If
Application.CutCopyMode = False

End If


Else

.Range("A1").Select

End If
End With

End Sub

VBA MACRO bdEvent_tyre.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/bdEvent_tyre'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Sub bd_tyre_byOp(control As IRibbonControl)

Dim lDbSpring As Long
Dim lproses As Integer
Dim lOperator As Long
Dim lTanggal As Integer
Dim i As Long
Dim DiffDate As Integer
Dim ws As Worksheet
Dim lrSum As Integer
Dim lcSum As Integer

Dim wsName As String: wsName = "DB Tyre"
If WorkSheetExists(wsName) Then

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("Proses").Delete
Sheets("WB").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "Proses"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80

lDbSpring = Sheets("DB Tyre").Cells(Sheets("DB Tyre").Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

MsgBox "Start Record"
DateVariable = CalendarForm.getDate
If DateVariable <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "End Record"
        DateVariable2 = CalendarForm.getDate
        If DateVariable2 <> 0 Then
            With Sheets("DB Tyre")
                Date1 = Format(DateVariable, "dd-mmm-yy")
                Date2 = Format(DateVariable2, "dd-mmm-yy")
                
                .AutoFilterMode = False
                .Range("A1:K" & lDbSpring).AutoFilter , Field:=4, Criteria1:= _
          ">=" & Date1, Operator:=xlAnd, Criteria2:="<=" & Date2
                .Range("A1:K" & lDbSpring).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
                Sheets("Proses").Cells(1, 1).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
                .AutoFilterMode = False
            End With
      
            With Sheets("Proses")
                lproses = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
             
                    .Range("I1:I" & lDbSpring).Replace "#N/A", ""
                    
                    .Range("I1:I" & lDbSpring).AdvancedFilter Action:=xlFilterCopy, CopyToRange:=Range("T1"), Unique:=True
                    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
                    lOperator = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 20).End(xlUp).Row
                    For i = lOperator To 1 Step -1
                        If IsEmpty(Cells(i, 20)) Then Cells(i, 20).Delete shift:=xlUp
                    Next i
            End With
            
            DiffDate = DateVariable2 - DateVariable
            
            With Sheets("By Operator")
                .Range("A1").value = "TYRE PROBLEM - DUMPTRUCK"
                .Range("A1").Interior.Color = RGB(0, 154, 0)
                .Range("A2:D2").Interior.Color = RGB(0, 255, 0)
                .Range("A1:D2").Font.Color = vbBlack
                
                lOperator = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
                lTanggal = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
                  'unmerge/merge area
                If .Range("A1:B1").Cells.Count > 1 Then
                    .Range("A1:B1").UnMerge
                    
                End If
                
                .Columns("E:AO").Delete
                
                If lOperator > 2 Then
                .Range("A3:E" & lOperator).ClearContents
                .Range(.Cells(3, 6), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).EntireRow.Delete
                
                End If
                 
                If lTanggal > 4 Then
                .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(2, lTanggal)).ClearContents
                End If
                .Cells(2, 5).value = DateVariable
                
                
                 lOperator = Sheets("Proses").Cells(.Rows.Count, 20).End(xlUp).Row
                    
                 Sheets("Proses").Range("T2:T" & lOperator).Copy
                .Range("C3").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
                'Date
                For i = 1 To DiffDate
                    .Cells(2, 5 + i).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-1]+1"
                Next i
                
                'count
                lTanggal = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
                For i = 1 To lTanggal - 4
                    For j = 1 To lOperator - 1
                        .Cells(j + 2, i + 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(COUNTIFS(Proses!C9,R" & 2 + j & "C3,Proses!C4,R2C" & i + 4 & ")=0,"""",COUNTIFS(Proses!C9,R" & 2 + j & "C3,Proses!C4,R2C" & i + 4 & "))"
                    
                    Next j
                Next i
                
                For i = 3 To lOperator + 1
                    .Cells(i, 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=SUM(RC5:RC" & lTanggal & ")"
                Next i
                '.Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).value = .Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).value
                
             
          
            'merge
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lTanggal)).Merge
            
            
            For i = 3 To lOperator + 1
            
                .Cells(i, 2).FormulaR1C1 = "=INDEX(Proses!R2C8:R" & lproses & "C8,MATCH(RC[1],Proses!R2C9:R" & lproses & "C9,0))"
                
            Next i
            
            '.Range("B2:B" & lOperator + 1).value = .Range("B2:B" & lOperator).value
            
            .Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).Sort Key1:=.Range("D2"), Order1:=xlDescending, Header:=xlYes, _
            OrderCustom:=1, MatchCase:=False, Orientation:=xlTopToBottom, _
            DataOption1:=xlSortNormal
            
            'Index
            lOperator = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 3).End(xlUp).Row
            For i = 1 To lOperator - 2
                .Cells(2 + i, 1).FormulaR1C1 = i
            Next i
            
            lrSum = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
            lcSum = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
            .Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).Interior.Color = RGB(252, 219, 214)
            
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(3, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum))
                 With rng.Borders
                    .LineStyle = xlContinuous
                    .Color = vbBlack
                    .Weight = xlThin
                End With
            '============== Header tanggal
            With .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(2, lcSum))
                .Interior.Color = RGB(252, 219, 214)
                .NumberFormat = "d mmm"
                .Font.Bold = True
            End With
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(2, lcSum))
                 With rng.Borders
                    .LineStyle = xlContinuous
                    .Color = vbBlack
                    .Weight = xlThin
                End With
                
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(2, lcSum))
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeBottom)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeTop)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
        
            .Range("A" & lrSum + 1).value = "Total"
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum)).Font.Bold = True
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 4)).Font.Size = 14
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 3)).Merge
            
            For i = 1 To lTanggal - 3
                .Cells(lrSum + 1, i + 3).FormulaR1C1 = "=SUM(R3C" & 3 + i & ":R" & lrSum & "C" & 3 + i & ")"
            Next i
          
          Set rng = .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum))
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeBottom)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeTop)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
            .UsedRange.value = .UsedRange.value
            
            '.Range("A2:A319" & lOperator + 1).AutoFilter , Field:=1, Criteria1:="<>"
            End With
           
      
            Sheets("Proses").Delete
            
   
            Sheets("By Operator").Activate
        
        
      
        Else
        
        Exit Sub
        End If
    Else
        Exit Sub
End If

Else
MsgBox "Buka Excel Master Breakdown"
End If
End Sub

VBA MACRO TTM_Update_HM.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/TTM_Update_HM'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Sub ttm_hm(control As IRibbonControl)

Dim nameFile As String
Dim SourceWb As Workbook
Dim actWB As Workbook
Dim lastsheet As Integer

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("HM").Delete
Sheets("HMDaily").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Set actWB = ActiveWorkbook
lastsheet = actWB.Sheets.Count
nameFile = Application.GetOpenFilename()

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "HMDaily"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80

On Error Resume Next
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False

Set SourceWb = Workbooks.Open(FileName:=nameFile, ReadOnly:=False)

Application.DisplayAlerts = True
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = True
On Error GoTo 0
If SourceWb Is Nothing Then
Exit Sub
Else
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
'    SourceWb.Sheets("Base").Cells.Copy
'    actWB.Worksheets("Data").Cells.PasteSpecial Paste:=xlPasteValues
    SourceWb.Sheets("Base").Name = "HM"
    SourceWb.Sheets("HM").Copy After:=actWB.Sheets(lastsheet)
    
    actWB.Sheets("HM").AutoFilterMode = False
    actWB.Sheets("HM").Visible = True

    
    SourceWb.Close
End If

With Sheets("HM")
Dim lastHM As Long
 DateVariable = CalendarForm.getDate
    If DateVariable <> 0 Then
    .Range("A1:Z1").UnMerge
lastHM = .Range("B" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    .Range("A1:Z" & lastHM).AutoFilter , Field:=4, Criteria1:=Format(DateVariable, "d-mmm-yy"), Field:=2, Criteria1:=2
    .Range("A1:Z" & lastHM).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
    Sheets("HMDaily").Range("A1").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
    End If
Sheets("HM").Delete
End With

With Sheets("Base")
Dim lastBaseRq As Integer
lastBaseRq = .Range("B" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
.Range("D2:D" & lastBaseRq).Copy
.Range("Q2").PasteSpecial

.Range("Q2:Q" & lastBaseRq).Replace "-", " "
Application.CutCopyMode = False
lastHM = Sheets("HMDaily").Range("B" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
For i = 2 To lastBaseRq
    .Cells(i, 11).FormulaR1C1 = "=VLOOKUP(RC[6],'HMDaily'!R2C2:R" & lastHM & "C23,7,FALSE)"
Next i

For i = 2 To lastBaseRq
    .Cells(i, 1).FormulaR1C1 = "=" & i - 1
Next i

.Range("K2:K" & lastBaseRq).value = .Range("K2:K" & lastBaseRq).value
.Columns("Q:Q").Delete
End With

Sheets("HMDaily").Delete
End Sub

            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum)).Font.Bold = True
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 4)).Font.Size = 14
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 3)).Merge
            
            For i = 1 To lTanggal - 3
                .Cells(lrSum + 1, i + 3).FormulaR1C1 = "=SUM(R3C" & 3 + i & ":R" & lrSum & "C" & 3 + i & ")"
            Next i
          
          Set rng = .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum))
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeBottom)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeTop)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            .UsedRange.value = .UsedRange.value
            
            '.Range("A2:A319" & lOperator + 1).AutoFilter , Field:=1, Criteria1:="<>"
            .UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
            .Activate
            
            Sheets("WB").Delete
            End With
           
      

Else
    Exit Sub
End If

  
  
  
Else
    bd_brake_byDT
End If

End Sub

VBA MACRO TTM_update_master.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/TTM_update_master'

Sub delete_DMBD()
Dim rng As Range
Dim lastDMBD As Integer
Dim lastBaseEq As Integer

With Sheets("DMBD")
lastDMBD = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
lastBaseEq = Sheets("Base Eq").Cells(Sheets("Base Eq").Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

Set rng = Sheets("Base Eq").Range("D:D")
For i = 2 To lastDMBD
    .Cells(i, 15).FormulaR1C1 = "=iferror(MATCH(RC[-13],'Base Eq'!R1C4:R" & lastBaseEq & "C4,0),"""")"
Next i

.Range("O2:O" & lastDMBD).value = .Range("O2:O" & lastDMBD).value


For i = lastDMBD To 2 Step -1
    If .Cells(i, 15).value = "" Then
        .Cells(i, 1).EntireRow.Delete
    End If
Next i

.Columns("O:O").Delete
End With
End Sub



Sub copyToMaster(control As IRibbonControl)

Dim nameFile As String
Dim wsCopy As Worksheet
Dim wsDest As Worksheet
Dim wsDest2 As Worksheet
Dim lCopyLastRow As Long
Dim lDestLastRow As Long
Dim lDestLastRow2 As Long
Dim lbaseEq As Long

nameFile = Application.GetOpenFilename()
Set DestWb = Workbooks.Open(FileName:=nameFile, ReadOnly:=False)

  Set wsCopy = Workbooks("Pre-To The Moon Report.xlsx").Worksheets("Base Eq")
  Set wsDest = DestWb.Worksheets("Base Equipment")
  Set wsDest2 = DestWb.Worksheets("Sheet1")

    lCopyLastRow = wsCopy.Cells(wsCopy.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    lDestLastRow = wsDest.Cells(wsDest.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Offset(1).Row
    lDestLastRow2 = wsDest.Cells(wsDest2.Rows.Count, "B").End(xlUp).Offset(1).Row
    
    wsDest.Range("D2:E" & lDestLastRow).ClearContents
    wsCopy.Range("B2:C" & lCopyLastRow).Copy
      wsDest.Range("D2").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
    wsCopy.Range("E2:K" & lCopyLastRow).Copy
      wsDest.Range("F2").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
      
    wsDest2.Range("B2:B" & lDestLastRow2).ClearContents
      wsCopy.Range("D2:D" & lCopyLastRow).Copy
      wsDest2.Range("B2").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues

'clean up data
    wsDest.Range("A" & lCopyLastRow + 1 & ":AB" & lDestLastRow).ClearContents


'DMBD
    Set wsCopy = Workbooks("Pre-To The Moon Report.xlsx").Worksheets("DMBD")
    Set wsDest = DestWb.Worksheets("DMBD")
    
    lCopyLastRow = wsCopy.Cells(wsCopy.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    lDestLastRow = wsDest.Cells(wsDest.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Offset(1).Row

    wsDest.Range("A2:M" & lDestLastRow).ClearContents
    wsCopy.Range("A2:M" & lCopyLastRow).Copy
    wsDest.Range("A2").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
    
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
      
      
End Sub

               ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("Graph Tofu").ChartObjects(1). _

               RGB(255, 255, 255)

Sub bd_suspension_byOp(control As IRibbonControl)

Dim lDbSpring As Long
Dim lproses As Integer
Dim lOperator As Long
Dim lTanggal As Integer
Dim i As Long
Dim DiffDate As Integer
Dim ws As Worksheet
Dim lrSum As Integer
Dim lcSum As Integer

Dim wsName As String: wsName = "DB Spring"
If WorkSheetExists(wsName) Then

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("Proses").Delete
Sheets("WB").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "Proses"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80

lDbSpring = Sheets("DB Spring").Cells(Sheets("DB Spring").Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

MsgBox "Start Record"
DateVariable = CalendarForm.getDate
If DateVariable <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "End Record"
        DateVariable2 = CalendarForm.getDate
        If DateVariable2 <> 0 Then
            With Sheets("DB Spring")
                Date1 = Format(DateVariable, "dd-mmm-yy")
                Date2 = Format(DateVariable2, "dd-mmm-yy")
                
                .AutoFilterMode = False
                .Range("A1:K" & lDbSpring).AutoFilter , Field:=4, Criteria1:= _
          ">=" & Date1, Operator:=xlAnd, Criteria2:="<=" & Date2
                .Range("A1:K" & lDbSpring).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
                Sheets("Proses").Cells(1, 1).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
                .AutoFilterMode = False
            End With
      
            With Sheets("Proses")
                lproses = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
             
                    .Range("I1:I" & lDbSpring).Replace "#N/A", ""
                    
                    .Range("I1:I" & lDbSpring).AdvancedFilter Action:=xlFilterCopy, CopyToRange:=Range("T1"), Unique:=True
                    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
                    lOperator = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 20).End(xlUp).Row
                    For i = lOperator To 1 Step -1
                        If IsEmpty(Cells(i, 20)) Then Cells(i, 20).Delete shift:=xlUp
                    Next i
            End With
            
            DiffDate = DateVariable2 - DateVariable
            
            With Sheets("By Operator")
                .Range("A1").value = "SUSPENSION PROBLEM - DUMPTRUCK"
                .Range("A1").Interior.Color = RGB(0, 0, 154)
                .Range("A2:D2").Interior.Color = RGB(0, 0, 255)
                .Range("A1:D2").Font.Color = vbWhite
                
                
                lOperator = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
                lTanggal = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
                  'unmerge/merge area
                If .Range("A1:B1").Cells.Count > 1 Then
                    .Range("A1:B1").UnMerge
                    
                End If
                
                .Columns("E:AO").Delete
                
                If lOperator > 2 Then
                .Range("A3:E" & lOperator).ClearContents
                .Range(.Cells(3, 6), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).EntireRow.Delete
                
                End If
                 
                If lTanggal > 4 Then
                .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(2, lTanggal)).ClearContents
                End If
                .Cells(2, 5).value = DateVariable
                
                
                 lOperator = Sheets("Proses").Cells(.Rows.Count, 20).End(xlUp).Row
                    
                 Sheets("Proses").Range("T2:T" & lOperator).Copy
                .Range("C3").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
                'Date
                For i = 1 To DiffDate
                    .Cells(2, 5 + i).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-1]+1"
                Next i
                
                'count
                lTanggal = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
                For i = 1 To lTanggal - 4
                    For j = 1 To lOperator - 1
                        .Cells(j + 2, i + 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(COUNTIFS(Proses!C9,R" & 2 + j & "C3,Proses!C4,R2C" & i + 4 & ")=0,"""",COUNTIFS(Proses!C9,R" & 2 + j & "C3,Proses!C4,R2C" & i + 4 & "))"
                    
                    Next j
                Next i
                
                For i = 3 To lOperator + 1
                    .Cells(i, 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=SUM(RC5:RC" & lTanggal & ")"
                Next i
                '.Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).value = .Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).value
                
             
          
            'merge
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lTanggal)).Merge
            
            
            For i = 3 To lOperator + 1
            
                .Cells(i, 2).FormulaR1C1 = "=INDEX(Proses!R2C8:R" & lproses & "C8,MATCH(RC[1],Proses!R2C9:R" & lproses & "C9,0))"
                
            Next i
            
            '.Range("B2:B" & lOperator + 1).value = .Range("B2:B" & lOperator).value
            
            .Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).Sort Key1:=.Range("D2"), Order1:=xlDescending, Header:=xlYes, _
            OrderCustom:=1, MatchCase:=False, Orientation:=xlTopToBottom, _
            DataOption1:=xlSortNormal
            
            'Index
            lOperator = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 3).End(xlUp).Row
            For i = 1 To lOperator - 2
                .Cells(2 + i, 1).FormulaR1C1 = i
            Next i
            
            lrSum = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
            lcSum = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
            .Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).Interior.Color = RGB(252, 219, 214)
            
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(3, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum))
                 With rng.Borders
                    .LineStyle = xlContinuous
                    .Color = vbBlack
                    .Weight = xlThin
                End With
            '============== Header tanggal
            With .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(2, lcSum))
                .Interior.Color = RGB(252, 219, 214)
                .NumberFormat = "d mmm"
                .Font.Bold = True
            End With
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(2, lcSum))
                 With rng.Borders
                    .LineStyle = xlContinuous
                    .Color = vbBlack
                    .Weight = xlThin
                End With
                
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(2, lcSum))
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeBottom)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeTop)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
        
            .Range("A" & lrSum + 1).value = "Total"
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum)).Font.Bold = True
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 4)).Font.Size = 14
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 3)).Merge
            
            For i = 1 To lTanggal - 3
                .Cells(lrSum + 1, i + 3).FormulaR1C1 = "=SUM(R3C" & 3 + i & ":R" & lrSum & "C" & 3 + i & ")"
            Next i
          
          Set rng = .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum))
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeBottom)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeTop)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
            .UsedRange.value = .UsedRange.value
            
            '.Range("A2:A319" & lOperator + 1).AutoFilter , Field:=1, Criteria1:="<>"
            End With
           
      
            Sheets("Proses").Delete
            
            Sheets("By Operator").Activate
        
        
      
        Else
        
        Exit Sub
        End If
    Else
        Exit Sub
End If

Else
MsgBox "Buka Excel Master Breakdown"
End If
End Sub

Sub update_byHM_opr1(control As IRibbonControl)


Dim wsName As String: wsName = "Master BD Hauling"
If WorkSheetExists(wsName) Then


Ans = MsgBox("Operator 1 ?", vbYesNo)
If Ans = vbYes Then


Dim x As Long, y As Long
Dim strAddr As String

Dim wbName As String
Dim wb As Workbook
wbName = "11. HM Unit.xlsb"
On Error Resume Next
Set wb = Workbooks(wbName)
On Error GoTo 0
If Not wb Is Nothing Then



strAddr = Selection.Address
    
x = Selection.Rows(1).Row
y = Selection.Rows.Count + x - 1

With Sheets("Master BD Hauling")
For i = x To y

    .Cells(i, 5).FormulaArray = "=IFERROR(INDEX('[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$Y:$Y,MATCH(1,(B" & i & "='[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$D:$D)*(C" & i & "='[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$B:$B)*(F" & i & "='[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$E:$E),0)),"""")"
    .Cells(i, 4).FormulaArray = "=IFERROR(INDEX('[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$L:$L,MATCH(1,(B" & i & "='[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$D:$D)*(C" & i & "='[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$B:$B)*(F" & i & "='[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$E:$E),0)),"""")"
Next i

.Range("D" & x & ":E" & y).value = .Range("D" & x & ":E" & y).value

End With


Else
    MsgBox "Buka Excel 11. HM Unit"
End If


Else
update_byHM_opr2
End If

Else

MsgBox "Buka Excel Master BD Hauling"
End If
End Sub

Sub update_byHM_opr2()

  Dim x As Long, y As Long
Dim strAddr As String

Dim wbName As String
Dim wb As Workbook

On Error Resume Next

On Error GoTo 0
If Not wb Is Nothing Then



strAddr = Selection.Address

y = Selection.Rows.Count + x - 1

With Sheets("Master BD Hauling")
For i = x To y

    .Cells(i, 5).FormulaArray = "=IFERROR(INDEX('[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$AA:$AA,MATCH(1,(B" & i & "='[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$D:$D)*(C" & i & "='[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$B:$B)*(F" & i & "='[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$E:$E),0)),"""")"
    .Cells(i, 4).FormulaArray = "=IFERROR(INDEX('[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$R:$R,MATCH(1,(B" & i & "='[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$D:$D)*(C" & i & "='[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$B:$B)*(F" & i & "='[11. HM Unit.xlsb]HM'!$E:$E),0)),"""")"

            End With
            
        
            .Range("A" & lrSum + 1).value = "Total"

            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 4)).Font.Size = 14
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 3)).Merge

            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            .UsedRange.value = .UsedRange.value
            
            '.Range("A2:A319" & lOperator + 1).AutoFilter , Field:=1, Criteria1:="<>"
            .UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
            .Activate

            End With
           
      

Else

        actWB.Sheets("Master BD Hauling").Range("A1:L" & lrow).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
        actWB.Sheets("WB").Cells(1, 1).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
        actWB.Sheets("Master BD Hauling").AutoFilterMode = False
        
Else
    Set actWB = ActiveWorkbook
    lastsheet = actWB.Sheets.Count
    
    MsgBox "Buka Excel Master BD Hauling"
    nameFile = Application.GetOpenFilename()

    On Error Resume Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False

    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Sheets("WB").Delete
    Sheets("By Operator").Delete
    On Error GoTo 0
    '
    
    Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
    Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "WB"
    ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80
    
    Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
    Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "By Operator"
    ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80


    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.AskToUpdateLinks = True
    Set SourceWb = Workbooks.Open(FileName:=nameFile, ReadOnly:=False)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If SourceWb Is Nothing Then
        Exit Sub
    Else
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False

        With ActiveWindow
        If .FreezePanes Then .FreezePanes = False
        End With

        SourceWb.Sheets("Master BD Hauling").Activate

        With SourceWb.Sheets("Master BD Hauling")
        .AutoFilterMode = False
        lrow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "F").End(xlUp).Row

        With .Range("A1:L" & lrow)
        '    .AutoFilter , Field:=7, Criteria1:=Format(dateVariable, "d-mmm-yy")
        '    .AutoFilter , Field:=8, Criteria1:=shift
            
            Date1 = Format(DateVariable, "dd-mmm-yy")
            Date2 = Format(DateVariable2, "dd-mmm-yy")
            
            .AutoFilter , Field:=2, Criteria1:= _
                  ">=" & Date1, Operator:=xlAnd, Criteria2:="<=" & Date2
        End With


        End With

'
'        Sheets("Master BD Hauling").Range("A1:L" & lrow).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
'        Sheets("WB").Cells(1, 1).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
        
        SourceWb.Sheets("Master BD Hauling").Range("A1:L" & lrow).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
        actWB.Sheets("WB").Cells(1, 1).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
        SourceWb.Sheets("Master BD Hauling").AutoFilterMode = False
        SourceWb.Sheets("Master BD Hauling").Application.CutCopyMode = False
        actWB.Activate
        SourceWb.Close
        End If
    End If

'========================================================================================= WB

'With Sheets("WB")
'    Dim lWb As Integer
'
'    lWb = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
'
'    For i = lWb To 1 Step -1
'        If .Cells(i, 4).value = "" Then
'            .Range(.Cells(i, 1), .Cells(i, 14)).EntireRow.Delete
'        End If
'    Next i
'
'    .Columns("A:B").Delete
'    .Columns("C").Delete
'    .Columns("G:J").Delete

'
'    .Columns("F").Cut
'    .Columns("A").Insert shift:=xlToRight
'
