'End With


With Sheets("WB")
lWb = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row


'Filter

For i = lWb To 2 Step -1
    If .Cells(i, 4).value <> "*BRAKE*" Then
        .Range(.Cells(i, 1), .Cells(i, 11)).EntireRow.Delete
    End If

Next i




'=============================


.Range("E2:E" & lWb).Copy
.Range("T1").PasteSpecial

.Range("T1:T" & lWb).RemoveDuplicates Columns:=Array(1), Header:=xlNo
.Range("T1:T" & lWb).Replace "#N/A", ""
For i = lWb To 1 Step -1

    If .Cells(i, 20).value = "" Then
        .Cells(i, 20).Delete shift:=xlUp
    End If

Next i

'========================================================= show
End With


DiffDate = DateVariable2 - DateVariable
            
            With Sheets("By DT")
                .Range("A1").value = "SUSPENSION PROBLEM - DUMPTRUCK BY DT"
                
                .Range("A2").value = "No."
                .Range("B2").value = "ID"
                .Range("C2").value = "Name"
                .Range("D2").value = "Qty"
                .Rows(1).RowHeight = 50
                .Rows(2).RowHeight = 30
                
                .Range("A1").Interior.Color = RGB(0, 0, 154)
                .Range("A2:D2").Interior.Color = RGB(0, 0, 255)
                .Range("A1:D2").Font.Color = vbWhite
                
                lOperator = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
                lTanggal = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
                  'unmerge/merge area
                If .Range("A1:B1").Cells.Count > 1 Then
                    .Range("A1:B1").UnMerge
                    
                End If
                
                .Columns("E:AO").Delete
                
                If lOperator > 2 Then
                .Range("A3:E" & lOperator).ClearContents
                .Range(.Cells(3, 6), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).EntireRow.Delete
                
                End If
                 
                If lTanggal > 4 Then
                .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(2, lTanggal)).ClearContents
                End If
                .Cells(2, 5).value = DateVariable
                
                
                 lOperator = Sheets("WB").Cells(Sheets("WB").Rows.Count, 20).End(xlUp).Row
                    
                 Sheets("WB").Range("T1:T" & lOperator).Copy
                .Range("C3").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
                
                'Date
                For i = 1 To DiffDate
                    .Cells(2, 5 + i).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-1]+1"
                Next i
                
                'count
                lTanggal = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
                For i = 1 To lTanggal - 4
                    For j = 1 To lOperator
                        .Cells(j + 2, i + 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(COUNTIFS(WB!C5,R" & 2 + j & "C3,WB!C2,R2C" & i + 4 & ")=0,"""",COUNTIFS(WB!C5,R" & 2 + j & "C3,WB!C2,R2C" & i + 4 & "))"
                    
                    Next j
                Next i
                
                For i = 3 To lOperator + 2
                    .Cells(i, 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=SUM(RC5:RC" & lTanggal & ")"
                Next i
                '.Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).value = .Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).value
                
             
          
            'merge
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lTanggal)).Merge
            
            
            'ORACLE
            For i = 3 To lOperator + 2
                
                .Cells(i, 2).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(INDEX(WB!R2C4:R" & lWb & "C4,MATCH(RC[1],WB!R2C5:R" & lWb & "C5,0))=0,"""",INDEX(WB!R2C4:R" & lWb & "C4,MATCH(RC[1],WB!R2C5:R" & lWb & "C5,0)))"
          
            Next i
            
           
             lOperator = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 3).End(xlUp).Row
            .Range("B3:C" & lOperator).value = .Range("B3:C" & lOperator).value
            
            .Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).Sort Key1:=.Range("D2"), Order1:=xlDescending, Header:=xlYes, _
            OrderCustom:=1, MatchCase:=False, Orientation:=xlTopToBottom, _
            DataOption1:=xlSortNormal
            
            'Index
           
            For i = 1 To lOperator - 2
                .Cells(2 + i, 1).FormulaR1C1 = i
            Next i
            
            lrSum = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
            lcSum = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
            .Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).Interior.Color = RGB(252, 219, 214)
            
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(3, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum))
                 With rng.Borders
                    .LineStyle = xlContinuous
                    .Color = vbBlack
                    .Weight = xlThin
                End With
            '============== Header tanggal
            With .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(2, lcSum))
                .Interior.Color = RGB(252, 219, 214)
                .NumberFormat = "d mmm"
                .Font.Bold = True
            End With
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(2, lcSum))
                 With rng.Borders
                    .LineStyle = xlContinuous
                    .Color = vbBlack
                    .Weight = xlThin
                End With
                
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(2, lcSum))
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeBottom)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeTop)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
        
            .Range("A" & lrSum + 1).value = "Total"
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum)).Font.Bold = True
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 4)).Font.Size = 14
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 3)).Merge
            
            For i = 1 To lTanggal - 3
                .Cells(lrSum + 1, i + 3).FormulaR1C1 = "=SUM(R3C" & 3 + i & ":R" & lrSum & "C" & 3 + i & ")"
            Next i
          
          Set rng = .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum))
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeBottom)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeTop)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            .UsedRange.value = .UsedRange.value
            
            '.Range("A2:A319" & lOperator + 1).AutoFilter , Field:=1, Criteria1:="<>"
            .UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
            .Activate
            .Columns(2).Delete
            Sheets("WB").Delete
            End With
           
      

Else
    Exit Sub
End If

End Sub

    MsgBox "Buka Excel Master BD Hauling"
    nameFile = Application.GetOpenFilename()

    On Error Resume Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False

    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Sheets("WB").Delete
    Sheets("By Operator").Delete
    On Error GoTo 0
    '
    
    Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
    Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "WB"
    ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80
    
    Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
    Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "By Operator"
    ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80


    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.AskToUpdateLinks = True
    Set SourceWb = Workbooks.Open(FileName:=nameFile, ReadOnly:=False)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If SourceWb Is Nothing Then
        Exit Sub
    Else
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False

        With ActiveWindow
        If .FreezePanes Then .FreezePanes = False
        End With

        SourceWb.Sheets("Master BD Hauling").Activate

        With SourceWb.Sheets("Master BD Hauling")
        .AutoFilterMode = False
        lrow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "F").End(xlUp).Row

        With .Range("A1:L" & lrow)
        '    .AutoFilter , Field:=7, Criteria1:=Format(dateVariable, "d-mmm-yy")
        '    .AutoFilter , Field:=8, Criteria1:=shift
            
            Date1 = Format(DateVariable, "dd-mmm-yy")
            Date2 = Format(DateVariable2, "dd-mmm-yy")
            
            .AutoFilter , Field:=2, Criteria1:= _
                  ">=" & Date1, Operator:=xlAnd, Criteria2:="<=" & Date2
        End With


        End With

'
'        Sheets("Master BD Hauling").Range("A1:L" & lrow).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
'        Sheets("WB").Cells(1, 1).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
        
        SourceWb.Sheets("Master BD Hauling").Range("A1:L" & lrow).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
        actWB.Sheets("WB").Cells(1, 1).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
        SourceWb.Sheets("Master BD Hauling").AutoFilterMode = False
        SourceWb.Sheets("Master BD Hauling").Application.CutCopyMode = False
        actWB.Activate
        SourceWb.Close
        End If
    End If

'========================================================================================= WB

'With Sheets("WB")
'    Dim lWb As Integer
'
'    lWb = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
'
'    For i = lWb To 1 Step -1
'        If .Cells(i, 4).value = "" Then
'            .Range(.Cells(i, 1), .Cells(i, 14)).EntireRow.Delete
'        End If
'    Next i
'
'    .Columns("A:B").Delete
'    .Columns("C").Delete
'    .Columns("G:J").Delete
'    .Columns("E").Delete
'
'    .Columns("D").NumberFormat = "dd-mmm-yy"
'
'    .Columns("F").Cut
'    .Columns("A").Insert shift:=xlToRight
'
'
'End With


With Sheets("WB")
lWb = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row


'Filter

For i = lWb To 2 Step -1
    If .Cells(i, 7).value <> "ES" Then
        .Range(.Cells(i, 1), .Cells(i, 11)).EntireRow.Delete
    End If

Next i




'=============================


.Range("C2:C" & lWb).Copy
.Range("T1").PasteSpecial
.Range("T1:T" & lWb).Replace "#N/A", ""
.Range("T1:T" & lWb).RemoveDuplicates Columns:=Array(1), Header:=xlNo

For i = lWb To 1 Step -1

    If .Cells(i, 20).value = "" Then
        .Cells(i, 20).Delete shift:=xlUp
    End If

Next i

'========================================================= show
End With


DiffDate = DateVariable2 - DateVariable
            
            With Sheets("By DT")
                .Range("A1").value = "SUSPENSION PROBLEM - DUMPTRUCK BY DT"
                
                .Range("A2").value = "No."
                .Range("B2").value = "ID"
                .Range("C2").value = "Name"
                .Range("D2").value = "Qty"
                .Rows(1).RowHeight = 50
                .Rows(2).RowHeight = 30
                
                .Range("A1").Interior.Color = RGB(0, 0, 154)
                .Range("A2:D2").Interior.Color = RGB(0, 0, 255)
                .Range("A1:D2").Font.Color = vbWhite
                
                lOperator = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
                lTanggal = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
                  'unmerge/merge area
                If .Range("A1:B1").Cells.Count > 1 Then
                    .Range("A1:B1").UnMerge
                    
                End If
                
                .Columns("E:AO").Delete
                
                If lOperator > 2 Then
                .Range("A3:E" & lOperator).ClearContents
                .Range(.Cells(3, 6), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).EntireRow.Delete
                
                End If
                 
                If lTanggal > 4 Then
                .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(2, lTanggal)).ClearContents
                End If
                .Cells(2, 5).value = DateVariable
                
                
                 lOperator = Sheets("WB").Cells(Sheets("WB").Rows.Count, 20).End(xlUp).Row
                    
                 Sheets("WB").Range("T1:T" & lOperator).Copy
                .Range("C3").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
                
                'Date
                For i = 1 To DiffDate
                    .Cells(2, 5 + i).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-1]+1"
                Next i
                
                'count
                lTanggal = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
                For i = 1 To lTanggal - 4
                    For j = 1 To lOperator
                        .Cells(j + 2, i + 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(COUNTIFS(WB!C3,R" & 2 + j & "C3,WB!C2,R2C" & i + 4 & ")=0,"""",COUNTIFS(WB!C3,R" & 2 + j & "C3,WB!C2,R2C" & i + 4 & "))"
                    
                    Next j
                Next i
                
                For i = 3 To lOperator + 2
                    .Cells(i, 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=SUM(RC5:RC" & lTanggal & ")"
                Next i
                '.Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).value = .Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).value
                
             
          
            'merge
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lTanggal)).Merge
            
            
            'ORACLE
'            For i = 3 To lOperator + 2
'
'                .Cells(i, 2).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(INDEX(WB!R2C4:R" & lWb & "C4,MATCH(RC[1],WB!R2C5:R" & lWb & "C5,0))=0,"""",INDEX(WB!R2C4:R" & lWb & "C4,MATCH(RC[1],WB!R2C5:R" & lWb & "C5,0)))"
'
'            Next i
            
           
             lOperator = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 3).End(xlUp).Row
            .Range("B3:C" & lOperator).value = .Range("B3:C" & lOperator).value
            
            .Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(lOperator + 1, lTanggal)).Sort Key1:=.Range("D2"), Order1:=xlDescending, Header:=xlYes, _
            OrderCustom:=1, MatchCase:=False, Orientation:=xlTopToBottom, _
            DataOption1:=xlSortNormal
            
            'Index
           
            For i = 1 To lOperator - 2
                .Cells(2 + i, 1).FormulaR1C1 = i
            Next i
            
            lrSum = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
            lcSum = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                
            .Range(.Cells(3, 4), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).Interior.Color = RGB(252, 219, 214)
            
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(3, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum))
                 With rng.Borders
                    .LineStyle = xlContinuous
                    .Color = vbBlack
                    .Weight = xlThin
                End With
            '============== Header tanggal
            With .Range(.Cells(2, 5), .Cells(2, lcSum))
                .Interior.Color = RGB(252, 219, 214)
                .NumberFormat = "d mmm"
                .Font.Bold = True
            End With
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(2, lcSum))
                 With rng.Borders
                    .LineStyle = xlContinuous
                    .Color = vbBlack
                    .Weight = xlThin
                End With
                
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(2, lcSum))
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeBottom)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeTop)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
        
            .Range("A" & lrSum + 1).value = "Total"
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum)).Font.Bold = True
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 4)).Font.Size = 14
            .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, 3)).Merge
            
            For i = 1 To lTanggal - 3
                .Cells(lrSum + 1, i + 3).FormulaR1C1 = "=SUM(R3C" & 3 + i & ":R" & lrSum & "C" & 3 + i & ")"
            Next i
          
          Set rng = .Range(.Cells(lrSum + 1, 1), .Cells(lrSum + 1, lcSum))
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeBottom)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            With rng.Borders(xlEdgeTop)
            .LineStyle = xlDouble
            .Weight = xlThick
            End With
            
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(lrSum, lcSum)).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            .UsedRange.value = .UsedRange.value
            
            '.Range("A2:A319" & lOperator + 1).AutoFilter , Field:=1, Criteria1:="<>"
            .UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
            .Activate
            .Columns(2).Delete
            Sheets("WB").Delete
            End With
           
      

Else
    Exit Sub
End If

End Sub

Sub searh_by_PS(control As IRibbonControl)

Dim lCol As Integer
Dim lrow As Integer

Dim wsName As String: wsName = "searchOpr"
If WorkSheetExists(wsName) Then

With Sheets("searchOpr")

lCol = .Cells(2, Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

'========================== Jika Nama yang diinput

lrow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, lCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lrow = 1 Then
        MsgBox "Input ManPower"
        Exit Sub
        Else
        
        ps

        If lCol = 6 Then
        
                If lrow > 1 Then
                    For i = 2 To lrow
                        .Cells(i, 1).FormulaR1C1 = i - 1
                        .Cells(i, 2).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C1,MATCH(RC[4],RR!C3,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 3).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C4,MATCH(RC[3],RR!C3,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C2,MATCH(RC[2],RR!C3,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 5).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C5,MATCH(RC[1],RR!C3,0)),"""")"
                    Next i
                End If
                
                
        ElseIf lCol = 5 Then
                
                If lrow > 1 Then
                    For i = 2 To lrow
                        .Cells(i, 1).FormulaR1C1 = i - 1
                        .Cells(i, 2).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C1,MATCH(RC[3],RR!C5,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 3).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C4,MATCH(RC[2],RR!C5,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C2,MATCH(RC[1],RR!C5,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 6).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C3,MATCH(RC[-1],RR!C5,0)),"""")"
                    Next i
                End If
                
        ElseIf lCol = 4 Then
                
                If lrow > 1 Then
                    For i = 2 To lrow
                        .Cells(i, 1).FormulaR1C1 = i - 1
                        .Cells(i, 2).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C1,MATCH(RC[2],RR!C2,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 3).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C4,MATCH(RC[1],RR!C2,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 5).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C5,MATCH(RC[-1],RR!C2,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 6).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C3,MATCH(RC[-2],RR!C2,0)),"""")"
                    Next i
                End If
                
         ElseIf lCol = 3 Then
                
                If lrow > 1 Then
                    For i = 2 To lrow
                        .Cells(i, 1).FormulaR1C1 = i - 1
                        .Cells(i, 2).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C1,MATCH(RC[1],RR!C4,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C2,MATCH(RC[-1],RR!C4,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 5).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C5,MATCH(RC[-2],RR!C4,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 6).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C3,MATCH(RC[-3],RR!C4,0)),"""")"
                    Next i
                End If
                
        ElseIf lCol = 2 Then
                
                If lrow > 1 Then
                    For i = 2 To lrow
                        .Cells(i, 1).FormulaR1C1 = i - 1
                        .Cells(i, 3).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C4,MATCH(RC[-1],RR!C1,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 4).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C2,MATCH(RC[-2],RR!C1,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 5).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C5,MATCH(RC[-3],RR!C1,0)),"""")"
                        .Cells(i, 6).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(RR!C3,MATCH(RC[-4],RR!C1,0)),"""")"
                    Next i
                End If
                
                
                
        End If
    
    .Range("A2:F" & lrow).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
    .Range("A2:F" & lrow).value = .Range("A2:F" & lrow).value
End If
End With

Else
MsgBox "Klik Toolbar Input"

VBA MACRO MR_HM_Req.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/MR_HM_Req'

Sub HM_req(control As IRibbonControl)

Dim lHm As Long
Dim lproses As Integer
Dim lOperator As Long
Dim lTanggal As Integer
Dim i As Long
Dim DiffDate As Integer
Dim ws As Worksheet
Dim lrSum As Integer
Dim lcSum As Integer

Dim nameFile As String
Dim SourceWb As Workbook
Dim actWB As Workbook
Dim lastsheet As Integer

MsgBox "Start Record"
DateVariable = CalendarForm.getDate
MsgBox "End Record"
DateVariable2 = CalendarForm.getDate


'==================================== Open File
open_HMunit_req
'====================================

lHm = Sheets("HMData").Cells(Sheets("HMData").Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row




Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("HM Req").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "HM Req"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80


If DateVariable <> 0 Then

 
        If DateVariable2 <> 0 Then
            With Sheets("HMData")
                .AutoFilterMode = False
                .UsedRange.value = .UsedRange.value
                
                Date1 = Format(DateVariable, "dd-mmm-yy")
                Date2 = Format(DateVariable2, "dd-mmm-yy")
                
                .AutoFilterMode = False
                .Range("A3:AO" & lHm).AutoFilter , Field:=4, Criteria1:= _
          ">=" & Date1, Operator:=xlAnd, Criteria2:="<=" & Date2
                .Range("A3:AO" & lHm).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
                Sheets("HM Req").Cells(1, 1).PasteSpecial Paste:=xlPasteValues
                Sheets("HM Req").Cells(1, 1).PasteSpecial Paste:=xlPasteFormats
                Application.CutCopyMode = False
                .AutoFilterMode = False
                With Sheets("HM Req")
                
                .Columns("Q:R").Delete
                .Columns("K:L").Delete
                .Columns("A").Delete
                .Columns("I").Cut
                .Columns("L").Insert shift:=xlToRight
                    
                .UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
                .UsedRange.Replace 0, "", MatchCase:=True, LookAt:=xlWhole
                .UsedRange.Replace "#VALUE!", ""
            
                lReq = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
                
                .Range("A2:AO" & lReq).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            
                Set sourceWs = ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("HM Req")
        
    
                sourceWs.Copy
        
    
                Set newWb = ActiveWorkbook
        
                Name = "HM Unit" & " " & Format(DateVariable, "yyyymmdd") & "-" & Format(DateVariable2, "yyyymmdd")
                
                sFileSaveName = Application.GetSaveAsFilename(InitialFileName:=Name, FileFilter:="Excel Files (*.xlsx), *.xlsx")
                
                    If sFileSaveName <> False Then
                        ActiveWorkbook.SaveAs sFileSaveName
                    End If
                
                Application.DisplayAlerts = False
                On Error Resume Next
                sourceWs.Delete
                On Error GoTo 0
    
            
                End With
        
            End With
      
        Else
            Exit Sub
        End If
Else
    Exit Sub
End If



End Sub

Sub summary_QC_NS()

Dim nameFile As String
Dim SourceWb As Workbook
Dim actWB As Workbook
Dim lastsheet As Integer

MsgBox "Open QC NS"

nameFile = Application.GetOpenFilename()
Set actWB = ActiveWorkbook
lastsheet = actWB.Sheets.Count

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("dataQcNS").Delete
Sheets("QCNS").Delete
Sheets("sync").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False



Application.DisplayAlerts = True
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = True
On Error Resume Next
Set SourceWb = Workbooks.Open(FileName:=nameFile, ReadOnly:=False)
On Error GoTo 0

If SourceWb Is Nothing Then
Exit Sub
Else
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
lastsheet = actWB.Sheets.Count

SourceWb.Sheets(1).Copy After:=actWB.Sheets(lastsheet)
    
 lastsheet = actWB.Sheets.Count
    actWB.Sheets(lastsheet).AutoFilterMode = False
    actWB.Sheets(lastsheet).Visible = True
    actWB.Sheets(lastsheet).Name = "QCNS"
    SourceWb.Close

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "dataQCNS"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80

Dim lproses, lprosescol, lQC As Integer

With Sheets("dataQCNS").Columns("A:A")
     If .EntireColumn.Hidden = True Then

End With

Sub delete_non_t0s_lmd_ds()

Dim lc As Integer
Dim lr As Long
Dim myString As String

With Sheets("dataQcDS")
 
lc = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
lr = .Cells(Rows.Count, "E").End(xlUp).Row

'=========================================================================== Saprolite
For i = 2 To lr

    If .Cells(i, 6).value = "SAPROLITE" Then
        lc = .Cells(i, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
        For j = lc To 8 Step -1
            myString = Trim(Cells(i, j).value)
             If InStr(myString, "TOS") = 0 Then
                .Cells(i, j).Delete shift:=xlToLeft
             End If
        
        Next j
    End If
Next i


'=========================================================================== Limonite
For i = 2 To lr

    If .Cells(i, 6).value = "LIMONITE" Then
        lc = .Cells(i, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
        For j = lc To 8 Step -1
            myString = Trim(Cells(i, j).value)
             If InStr(myString, "LD") = 0 Then
                .Cells(i, j).Delete shift:=xlToLeft
             End If
        
        Next j
    End If
Next i



End With


End Sub

in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/pdb_QC_prodID_0'

Sub prod_id()
Dim lSummaryDS As Long
Dim lSummaryNS As Long

With Sheets("SummaryDS")

lSummaryDS = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

    For i = 2 To lSummaryDS
    
        If .Cells(i, 10).value <> "" And .Cells(i, 15).value <> "TS" Then
        
            .Cells(i, 9).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(VALUE(RIGHT(RC[1],1)))=TRUE,ISNUMBER(VALUE(RIGHT(RC[1],1)))=TRUE),LEFT(RC[1],LEN(RC[1])),LEFT(RC[1],LEN(RC[1])-1))"
        End If
    
    Next i
    
    
    For i = 2 To lSummaryDS
    
        If .Cells(i, 15).value = "TS" Then
            .Cells(i, 9).value = .Cells(i, 10).value
            .Cells(i, 10).ClearContents
        End If
    
    Next i
    
    .Range("I2:I" & lSummaryDS).value = .Range("I2:I" & lSummaryDS).value

End With






With Sheets("SummaryNS")

lSummaryNS = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

    For i = 2 To lSummaryNS
    
        If .Cells(i, 10).value <> "" And .Cells(i, 15).value <> "TS" Then
        
            .Cells(i, 9).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(VALUE(RIGHT(RC[1],1)))=TRUE,ISNUMBER(VALUE(RIGHT(RC[1],1)))=TRUE),LEFT(RC[1],LEN(RC[1])),LEFT(RC[1],LEN(RC[1])-1))"
        End If
    
    Next i
    
       For i = 2 To lSummaryNS
    
        If .Cells(i, 15).value = "TS" Then
            .Cells(i, 9).value = .Cells(i, 10).value
            .Cells(i, 10).ClearContents
            
        End If
    
    Next i
    
      .Range("I2:I" & lSummaryNS).value = .Range("I2:I" & lSummaryNS).value

End With

End Sub

Sub proses_room_qc_ds()

With Sheets("sync")

Dim lsyncRoom As Integer
Dim lsyncQC As Integer
Dim lritColRoom As Integer
Dim lRit As Integer
Dim i As Integer
Dim j As Integer
Dim iCol As Integer

lsyncRoom = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "O").End(xlUp).Row
lsyncQC = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "D").End(xlUp).Row

If lsyncRoom > 1 Then

For i = 2 To lsyncQC 'lsyncQc

    .Cells(2, 16).FormulaR1C1 = "=SumSolver(R" & i & "C4,R2C15:R" & lsyncRoom & "C15)"
    .Cells(2, 16).value = .Cells(2, 16).value
    .Cells(2, 16).TextToColumns DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
    
    lritColRoom = .Cells(2, Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    
    .Range(.Cells(2, 16), .Cells(2, lritColRoom)).Copy
    .Cells(3, 16).PasteSpecial Transpose:=True
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    .Range(.Cells(2, 16), .Cells(2, lritColRoom)).ClearContents
    
    lRit = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "p").End(xlUp).Row
    On Error Resume Next
    If lRit > 3 Then
    .Range("P3:P" & lRit).Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeBlanks).Delete shift:=xlUp
    End If
    
        For j = 3 To lRit
        .Cells(j, 17).FormulaR1C1 = "=MATCH(RC[-1],R1C15:R" & lsyncRoom & "C15,FALSE)"
        .Cells(j, 17).value = .Cells(j, 17).value
        
        Dim a As Integer
        a = .Cells(j, 17).value
        
        .Cells(a, 10).value = .Cells(i, 3).value
        .Cells(a, 11).value = .Cells(i, 8).value
        .Cells(a, 12).value = .Cells(i, 7).value
        .Cells(a, 15).ClearContents
        Next j
    .Range("P3:Q" & lRit).ClearContents
Next i

'=================================================== Copy to PDB NS
    Dim rng1 As Range
    Dim rng2 As Range
    Dim InputRng As Range
    Dim OutRng As Range
    Dim lrSync As Integer
    Dim lrPdb As Integer
    Dim frPdb As Integer
    
   With Worksheets("SummaryDS").AutoFilter.Range
       frPdb = .Range("A" & .Offset(1, 0).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible)(1).Row).Row
       lrPdb = .Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    End With
    
    lrSync = .Range("J" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    
    '==================== ProdID ID
    Set InputRng = .Range("J2:J" & lrSync)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("SummaryDS").Range("J" & frPdb & ":J" & lrPdb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    
    
    '==================== Destination
    'If .Range("F2") <> "WASTE" Then
    Set InputRng = .Range("K2:K" & lrSync)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("SummaryDS").Range("Q" & frPdb & ":Q" & lrPdb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    
      '==================== Pile ID
    Set InputRng = .Range("L2:L" & lrSync)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("SummaryDS").Range("R" & frPdb & ":R" & lrPdb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    
    'End If
End If
End With

Sheets("SummaryDS").AutoFilterMode = False
Sheets("dataQCDS").AutoFilterMode = False

End Sub

Sub trim_tos_dome()

On Error Resume Next

    With Application.WorksheetFunction
    For Each r In Intersect(Selection, Sheets("SummaryDS").UsedRange)
        r.value = .Trim(r.value)
    Next r
    
     For Each r In Intersect(Selection, Sheets("SummaryDS").UsedRange)
        r.value = .Trim(r.value)
    Next r
    End With
End Sub

VBA MACRO pdb_hauling_import_operator.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/pdb_hauling_import_operator'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Sub import_operator(control As IRibbonControl)


Dim nameFile As String
Dim SourceWb As Workbook
Dim actWB As Workbook
Dim lastsheet As Integer
Dim path As String, file As String

MsgBox "Open Personnel Strength"
Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("PS").Delete
On Error GoTo 0


open_file_ps


 path = "P:\02.Share by ENGINEERING\125. DAILY FILE\"
 file = "NewConverter"

Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("Import Operator").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

DateVariable = CalendarForm.getDate
If DateVariable <> 0 Then

    Set actWB = ActiveWorkbook
    actWB.Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
    actWB.Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "Import Operator"
    ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80

        If Dir(path & file & ".xlsx") <> "" Then
    
        '=============================== Converter
            On Error Resume Next
            Application.DisplayAlerts = False
            Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False

            Set SourceWb = Workbooks.Open(path & file & ".xlsx")

        Else

            MsgBox "Buka HM Unit"
            nameFile = Application.GetOpenFilename()

            On Error Resume Next
            Application.DisplayAlerts = False
            Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False
            Set SourceWb = Workbooks.Open(FileName:=nameFile, ReadOnly:=False)
        End If

    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.AskToUpdateLinks = True



    On Error GoTo 0
    If SourceWb Is Nothing Then
        Exit Sub
    Else

        Dim lrow As Long

        With SourceWb.Sheets("dbWB SMA")
        lrow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

        .AutoFilterMode = False
        Application.Calculation = xlManual
        
        .Range("A2:AT" & lrow).AutoFilter , Field:=16, Criteria1:=Format(DateVariable, "dd-mmm-yy"), Operator:=xlOr, Criteria2:=Format(DateVariable, "d-mmm-yy")
        '.Range("A3:AT" & lrow).AutoFilter , Field:=12, Criteria1:="<>"
        
        ThisWorkbook.UpdateLinks = xlUpdateLinksNever
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        
        .Range("A3:AT" & lrow).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
        
        actWB.Sheets("Import Operator").Cells(1, 1).PasteSpecial
        
        ThisWorkbook.UpdateLinks = xlUpdateLinksAlways
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
        
        End With

    End If
End If

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
SourceWb.Close
a
End Sub

Sub a()
    
    
'With actWB.Sheets("Import Operator")

With Sheets("Import Operator")

Dim lActWb As Integer
Dim lrow As Long

lActWb = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row



.Columns("AF:AT").Delete
.Columns("R:AD").Delete
.Columns("H:O").Delete
.Columns("E:A").Delete

.Columns("C:D").Cut
.Columns(1).EntireColumn.Insert

.Columns(5).Cut
.Columns(4).EntireColumn.Insert

.UsedRange.value = .UsedRange.value

lrow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

For i = 1 To lrow
    .Cells(i, 6).FormulaR1C1 = "=IF(RC[-1]<1000,""SMAW0""&RC[-1],IF(RC[-1]>10000,""SMA""&RC[-1],""SMAW""&RC[-1]))"
Next i

.Range("F1:F" & lrow).value = .Range("F1:F" & lrow).value

For i = 1 To lrow
    .Cells(i, 5).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(VLOOKUP(RC[1],PS!C6:C8,3,FALSE),VLOOKUP(RC[1],PS!C7:C8,2,FALSE))"
Next i

.Range("E1:E" & lrow).value = .Range("E1:E" & lrow).value

.Range("D1:D" & lrow).Replace What:=" ", Replacement:="-", _
        SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, MatchCase:=False
.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit


Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Sheets("PS").Delete
'.Columns("J:L").Delete
'.Columns("F:H").Delete
'.Columns("C:C").Delete
'.Columns("A:A").Delete
'
'
'.Columns("B").Cut
'.Columns("A").Insert shift:=xlToRight
'.Columns("C").Cut
'.Columns("B").Insert shift:=xlToRight
'.Columns("E").Cut
'.Columns("D").Insert shift:=xlToRight
'
'.Columns("F:F").Delete
'
'For i = 2 To lActWb
'    If .Cells(i, 5).value > 2000000 Then
'        .Cells(i, 6).FormulaR1C1 = "=""SMA""&RC[-1]"
'    Else
'
'        .Cells(i, 6).FormulaR1C1 = "=""SMAW""&RC[-1]"
'    End If
'Next i
'
'.Range("E2:E" & lActWb).value = .Range("F2:F" & lActWb).value
'.Range("F2:F" & lActWb).ClearContents
'.Columns("C").EntireColumn.Insert
'
'.Range("C2:C" & lActWb).value = "SMA"
'
'
' .Columns("D").Replace What:=" ", Replacement:="-", _
'        SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, MatchCase:=True
'
'.Range("C1").value = "Contractor"
'.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
'.UsedRange.value = .UsedRange.value
End With

End Sub

VBA MACRO audb__activity_location_unit.bas

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Sub audb_activity_location(control As IRibbonControl)

Dim lPDB As Integer
Dim lactLoc As Integer
Dim lfiltered As Integer
Dim vfilter
Dim rRange As Range
Dim fltdRange As Range
Dim n As Integer


With Sheets("PDB")
    .Columns("N").Cells.Replace What:=" ", Replacement:="-", _
            LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
            SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
End With



Dim wsName As String: wsName = "audb_act_loc"
If WorkSheetExists(wsName) Then


'=============================================================================== List Exca TOS POS

lactLoc = Sheets("audb_act_loc").Cells(Sheets("audb_act_loc").Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

With Sheets("AUDB")
lAudb = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

For i = 2 To lactLoc

 
    .ListObjects(1).AutoFilter.ShowAllData

Sub rit_norit(control As IRibbonControl)


Dim lAudb As Integer
Dim lPDB As Integer

With Sheets("AUDB")
lAudb = .Range("A" & .Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
lPDB = Sheets("PDB").Range("A" & Sheets("PDB").Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row

'========================================== ADT ada ritasi hapus stby n BD, WH jadi 1
For i = 2 To lAudb
    If .Cells(i, 9).value = "1stHauling" Then
        .Cells(i, 21).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFERROR(IF(RC[-12]=""1stHauling"",INDEX(PDB!R2C15:R" & lPDB & "C15,(SUMPRODUCT(MATCH(1,(PDB!R2C4:R" & lPDB & "C4=RC[-17])*(PDB!R2C12:R" & lPDB & "C12=RC[-11]),0)))),0),0)"
    End If
Next i


For i = 2 To lAudb
    If .Cells(i, 9).value = "1stHauling" And .Cells(i, 21).value <> 0 And .Cells(i, 17) = 0 Then
        .Cells(i, 11).value = 0
        .Cells(i, 12).value = ""
        .Cells(i, 13).value = 0
        .Cells(i, 14).value = ""
        .Cells(i, 15).value = 0
        .Cells(i, 16).value = ""
        .Cells(i, 17).value = 1

    End If
Next i

.Range("U2:U" & lAudb).ClearContents


'========================================== Exca ada ritasi hapus stby n BD, WH jadi 1
For i = 2 To lAudb
    If .Cells(i, 9).value = "1stLoading" Then
        .Cells(i, 21).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(INDEX(PDB!R2C15:R" & lPDB & "C15,(SUMPRODUCT(MATCH(1,(PDB!R2C4:R" & lPDB & "C4=RC[-17])*(PDB!R2C14:R" & lPDB & "C14=RC[-11]),0)))),0)"
    End If
Next i


For i = 2 To lAudb
    If .Cells(i, 9).value = "1stLoading" And .Cells(i, 21).value <> 0 And .Cells(i, 17) = 0 Then
        .Cells(i, 11).value = 0
        .Cells(i, 12).value = ""
        .Cells(i, 13).value = 0
        .Cells(i, 14).value = ""
        .Cells(i, 15).value = 0
        .Cells(i, 16).value = ""
        .Cells(i, 17).value = 1
'        .Cells(i, 18).Interior.Color = RGB(120, 120, 120)

    End If
Next i

.Range("U2:U" & lAudb).ClearContents

'========================================== ADT NonProduction
open_file_nonProduksi

'Jika tanggalnya sama (ditakutkan tidak ada nn produksi di hari yang dirunning)
If Sheets("AUDB").Range("A2").value = Sheets("NonProduksi").Range("A2").value Then

With Sheets("NonProduksi").Range("B:C")
    .NumberFormat = "0"
    .value = .value
End With


For i = 2 To lAudb
    If .Cells(i, 9).value = "1stHauling" Then
        .Cells(i, 21).FormulaArray = "=IFNA(INDEX(NonProduksi!C2,(SUMPRODUCT(MATCH(1,(NonProduksi!C1=RC[-17])*(NonProduksi!C9=RC[-11]),0)))),0)"
        .Cells(i, 21).value = .Cells(i, 21).value
    End If
Next i

For i = 2 To lAudb
    If .Cells(i, 21).value > 0 Then
        .Cells(i, 15).value = 1
        .Cells(i, 16).value = "S20"
        .Cells(i, 17).value = 0
    End If
Next i

.Range("U2:U" & lAudb).ClearContents

End If
'====================================================================== Sisa Hour ADT BD

'For i = 2 To lAudb
'    If .Cells(i, 13).value > 0 And .Cells(i, 13).value < 1 Then

'        .Cells(i, 16).value = "S17"
'        .Cells(i, 17).value = 0
'    End If
'Next i



'========================================== ADT tidak ada ritasi tapi WH > 0
For i = 2 To lAudb
    If .Cells(i, 9).value = "1stHauling" Then
        .Cells(i, 21).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFERROR(IF(RC[-12]=""1stHauling"",INDEX(PDB!R2C15:R" & lPDB & "C15,(SUMPRODUCT(MATCH(1,(PDB!R2C4:R" & lPDB & "C4=RC[-17])*(PDB!R2C12:R" & lPDB & "C12=RC[-11]),0)))),0),0)"
    End If
Next i


For i = 2 To lAudb
    If .Cells(i, 9).value = "1stHauling" And .Cells(i, 21).value <> 0 And .Cells(i, 16) = "" And .Cells(i, 17) = 0 Then
        .Cells(i, 11).value = 0
        .Cells(i, 12).value = ""
        .Cells(i, 13).value = 0
        .Cells(i, 14).value = ""
        .Cells(i, 15).value = 0
        .Cells(i, 16).value = ""
        .Cells(i, 17).value = 1
    End If
    
      If .Cells(i, 9).value = "1stHauling" And .Cells(i, 21).value = 0 And .Cells(i, 17) > 0 Then
        .Cells(i, 22).value = "Cek"
    End If

With Sheets("fix")

.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit

Dim myrng As Range
Dim myrng2 As Range
Dim LastCell As Range
Dim cell As Range

 Set myrng = .Range("J2:J" & .Range("A" & .Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row)
 Set myrng2 = .Range("A2:S" & .Range("A" & .Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row)

With myrng
        Set LastCell = .Cells(.Cells.Count)
    End With

 myrng.Interior.ColorIndex = xlNone
    clr = 3
    
    
For Each cell In myrng
        If Application.WorksheetFunction.CountIf(myrng, cell) > 1 Then
            If myrng.find(What:=cell, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False, After:=LastCell).Address = cell.Address Then
                cell.Interior.ColorIndex = clr
               clr = clr + 1
            Else
                cell.Interior.ColorIndex = myrng.find(What:=cell, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False, After:=LastCell).Interior.ColorIndex
            End If
        End If
    Next


End With
'.Range("U2:U" & lAuDB).ClearContents

End Sub


Sub fix_no_rit_adt(control As IRibbonControl)

Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic

Dim rng1 As Range
    Dim rng2 As Range
    Dim InputRng As Range
    Dim OutRng As Range
    Dim lrFix As Integer
    Dim lrAudb As Integer
    Dim frAudb As Integer
    
   With Worksheets("AUDB").AutoFilter.Range
       frAudb = .Range("A" & .Offset(1, 0).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible)(1).Row).Row
       lrAudb = .Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    End With
    
    lrFix = Sheets("fix").Range("A" & Sheets("fix").Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    If lrFix > 1 Then
    '==================== schDowntime
    Set InputRng = Sheets("fix").Range("K2:K" & lrFix)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("AUDB").Range("K" & frAudb & ":K" & lrAudb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    
     '==================== Unschd Time
    Set InputRng = Sheets("fix").Range("K2:K" & lrFix)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("AUDB").Range("K" & frAudb & ":K" & lrAudb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    
     '==================== schCode
    Set InputRng = Sheets("fix").Range("L2:L" & lrFix)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("AUDB").Range("L" & frAudb & ":L" & lrAudb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    
     '==================== uschDowntime
    Set InputRng = Sheets("fix").Range("M2:M" & lrFix)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("AUDB").Range("M" & frAudb & ":M" & lrAudb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    
     '====================uschCode
    Set InputRng = Sheets("fix").Range("N2:N" & lrFix)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("AUDB").Range("N" & frAudb & ":N" & lrAudb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    
     '==================== standby
    Set InputRng = Sheets("fix").Range("O2:O" & lrFix)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("AUDB").Range("O" & frAudb & ":O" & lrAudb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    
     '==================== standbyCode
    Set InputRng = Sheets("fix").Range("P2:p" & lrFix)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("AUDB").Range("P" & frAudb & ":P" & lrAudb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    
     '==================== workhours
    Set InputRng = Sheets("fix").Range("Q2:Q" & lrFix)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("AUDB").Range("Q" & frAudb & ":Q" & lrAudb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    Application.CutCopyMode = False

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Sheets("fix").Delete

End If

With Sheets("AUDB")
.Select
lAudb = Sheets("AUDB").Range("A" & Sheets("AUDB").Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
 If .FilterMode = True Then
           .ShowAllData
 End If
 
 .Range("U1:V" & lAudb).ClearContents
End With
End Sub

VBA MACRO TTM_daily.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/TTM_daily'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Sub daily_ttm(control As IRibbonControl)
Dim wks As Worksheet, objList As ListObject
Dim lTTM As Integer
Dim MySheetName As String
Dim c As Range


Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("Result").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

If Sheets("DMBD").Range("A1").value = "No" Then
 '=========================================================================================== Hauling
        With Sheets("DMBD")
        MySheetName = "Result"
        Sheets("DMBD").Copy After:=Sheets("DMBD")
        ActiveSheet.Name = MySheetName
        
        On Error Resume Next
        .ListObjects(1).AutoFilter.ShowAllData
        
        
    
        
        End With
        
        With Sheets("Result")
        
        For Each objList In .ListObjects
            objList.Unlist
        Next objList
        
        lTTM = .Range("k" & .Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
        
        .UsedRange.value = .UsedRange.value
        .Columns(3).Delete
        .Columns("I").Cut
        .Columns("L").Insert shift:=xlToRight

        
        .UsedRange.Replace What:="#N/A", Replacement:="", LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder _
                :=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False _
                , FormulaVersion:=xlReplaceFormula2
        
        .Rows(lTTM + 1 & ":" & lTTM + 20).EntireRow.Delete
        
        
        For Each c In .Range("D2:D" & lTTM)
            If Not (IsEmpty(c) Or IsError(c) Or IsFormula(c)) Then
              c.value = Trim(c.value)
              c.value = StrConv(c.value, vbProperCase)
            End If
        Next c
        
        
        End With


 Else


 '=========================================================================================== Mining
        With Sheets("DMBD")
        
        .UsedRange.value = .UsedRange.value
        MySheetName = "Result"
        Sheets("DMBD").Copy After:=Sheets("DMBD")
        ActiveSheet.Name = MySheetName
        
        On Error Resume Next
        .ListObjects(1).AutoFilter.ShowAllData
        
        End With
        
        With Sheets("Result")
        
       
        
        For Each objList In .ListObjects
            objList.Unlist
        Next objList
        
        lTTM = .Range("B" & .Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
      
        
        .Columns(3).Delete
        .Columns("J").Cut
        .Columns("I").Insert shift:=xlToRight
        
        .Columns("K").Cut
        .Columns("J").Insert shift:=xlToRight
        
        .UsedRange.Replace What:="#N/A", Replacement:="", LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder _
                :=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False _
                , FormulaVersion:=xlReplaceFormula2
                
       
        
        .Rows(lTTM + 1 & ":" & lTTM + 20).EntireRow.Delete
        
        For Each c In .Range("D2:D" & lTTM)
            If Not (IsEmpty(c) Or IsError(c) Or IsFormula(c)) Then
              c.value = Trim(c.value)
              c.value = StrConv(c.value, vbProperCase)
            End If
        Next c
        
        End With


End If

rename_ttm
End Sub




Sub rename_ttm()



    
        With Sheets("Result")
              .Columns("K").Cells.Replace What:="WAITING PART", Replacement:="Waiting Part", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("K").Cells.Replace What:="Waiting Part", Replacement:="Waiting for Part", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("K").Cells.Replace What:="WAITING LABOUR", Replacement:="Waiting Manpower", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("K").Cells.Replace What:="IN PROGRESS", Replacement:="On Progress", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("I").Cells.Replace What:="ACCIDENT", Replacement:="UNSCHEDULED", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
            
            .Columns("H").Cells.Replace What:="ACCIDENT", Replacement:="DUMP BODY", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("H").Cells.Replace What:="UNIT ACCIDENT", Replacement:="DUMP BODY", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="ACCIDENT", Replacement:="DUMP BODY", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="UNIT ACCIDENT", Replacement:="DUMP BODY", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
            
            .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="UNIT DUMP BODY", Replacement:="DUMP BODY", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
            .Columns("H").Cells.Replace What:="UNIT DUMP BODY", Replacement:="DUMP BODY", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
            .Columns("K").Cells.Replace What:="WAITING-LABOUR", Replacement:="Waiting Manpower", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("K").Cells.Replace What:="WAITING REFURBISH", Replacement:="Waiting Part", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("K").Cells.Replace What:="WAITING SPACE", Replacement:="Waiting Part", _
                        LookAt:=xlPart, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            '====================================================================================================== BD STATUS
             .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="UNDERCARRIAGE", Replacement:="Undercarriage", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="CABIN", Replacement:="Dump Body", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="AC SYSTEM", Replacement:="Air Conditioner", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="DUMP BODY", Replacement:="Dump Body", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="Electric", Replacement:="Electrical System", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
            
            .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="Brake", Replacement:="Braking", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
             .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="Hydraulic", Replacement:="Hydraulic System", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
             .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="Body", Replacement:="Dump Body", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
             .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="Engine Group", Replacement:="Engine", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
            
            .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="Tire", Replacement:="Tyre", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
             .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="Power Train", Replacement:="Transmission", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
             .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="Pm Service", Replacement:="Preventive Maintenance", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="Cabin", Replacement:="Dump Body", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
            .Columns("D").Cells.Replace What:="Frame", Replacement:="Undercarriage", _
                        LookAt:=xlWhole, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=True, _
                        SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
                        
                        
            End With
 

End Sub

VBA MACRO weekly_adt_dt_running.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/weekly_adt_dt_running'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Sub dt_running(control As IRibbonControl)

Dim lConverter As Long
Dim lproses As Integer
Dim DiffDate As Integer
Dim DateVariable
Dim DateVariable2
Dim j As Integer
Dim i As Integer

Dim lastcolumn As Integer

Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("Proses").Delete
Sheets("DT RUNNING").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "Proses"

ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80




DateVariable = CalendarForm.getDate
If DateVariable <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "End Record"
        DateVariable2 = CalendarForm.getDate
        If DateVariable2 <> 0 Then
        
'========================================================== Block Open
open_newConverter
'==========================================================
lConverter = Sheets("dbWB SMA").Cells(Sheets("dbWB SMA").Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

            DiffDate = DateVariable2 - DateVariable
            With Sheets("dbWB SMA")
              
                j = 0
                
                For i = 0 To DiffDate
                .AutoFilterMode = False
                Date1 = Format(DateVariable + i, "d-mmm-yy")
                'Date2 = Format(DateVariable2, "dd-mmm-yy")
                .Range("D1:Q" & lConverter).AutoFilter , Field:=13, Criteria1:=Date1
                .Range("D1:Q" & lConverter).AutoFilter , Field:=14, Criteria1:=1
                .Range("D1:D2").UnMerge
                .Range("D1:D" & lConverter).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
                Sheets("Proses").Cells(4, (j * 2) + 1).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
                
                Sheets("Proses").Cells(1, (i * 2) + 1).value = Date1
                Sheets("Proses").Cells(2, (i * 2) + 1).value = "DS"
                
                 .AutoFilterMode = False
                .Range("D1:Q" & lConverter).AutoFilter , Field:=13, Criteria1:=Date1
                .Range("D1:Q" & lConverter).AutoFilter , Field:=14, Criteria1:=2
                .Range("D1:D2").UnMerge
                .Range("D1:D" & lConverter).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
                Sheets("Proses").Cells(4, (j * 2) + 2).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
                
                Sheets("Proses").Cells(1, (i * 2) + 2).value = Date1
                Sheets("Proses").Cells(2, (i * 2) + 2).value = "NS"
                .AutoFilterMode = False
                j = j + 1
                Next i
            End With
      
            With Sheets("Proses")
                lastcolumn = .Cells(1, Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                    
                    For i = 1 To lastcolumn
                        lproses = .Cells(.Rows.Count, i).End(xlUp).Row
                        .Range(.Cells(4, i), .Cells(lproses, i)).RemoveDuplicates Columns:=Array(1), Header:=xlYes
                    Next i
                    

                     
                    For i = 1 To lastcolumn
                      
                        lproses = .Cells(.Rows.Count, i).End(xlUp).Row
                        .Cells(3, i).FormulaR1C1 = "=COUNTA(R[2]C" & i & ":R" & lproses & "C" & i & ")"

                    Next i
                        
                .UsedRange.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeBlanks).Delete shift:=xlUp
                        
                .Range(.Cells(3, 1), .Cells(3, lastcolumn)).value = .Range(.Cells(3, 1), .Cells(3, lastcolumn)).value
            
            
            '==================================================================================== TRANSPOSE
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lastcolumn)).Copy
            .Cells(2, lastcolumn + 2).PasteSpecial Transpose:=True
            
            .Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(2, lastcolumn)).Copy
            .Cells(2, lastcolumn + 3).PasteSpecial Transpose:=True
            
            .Range(.Cells(3, 1), .Cells(3, lastcolumn)).Copy
            .Cells(2, lastcolumn + 4).PasteSpecial Transpose:=True
            
                    For i = 1 To lastcolumn
                        lproses = .Cells(.Rows.Count, i).End(xlUp).Row
                        .Range(.Cells(5, i), .Cells(lproses, i)).Copy
                        .Cells(i + 1, lastcolumn + 5).PasteSpecial Transpose:=True
                        
                    Next i
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lastcolumn + 1)).EntireColumn.Delete
            
            '============================== Merge
            
            lproses = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
            
            For i = 1 To (lproses - 1) / 2
                .Range("A" & i * 2 & ":A" & (i * 2) + 1).Merge
            Next i
            
            
            .Range("A1").value = "Tanggal"
            .Range("B1").value = "Shift"
            .Range("C1").value = "Total"
            
            .UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
            .UsedRange.Columns.HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            .UsedRange.Columns.VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
            
            Dim lcolumn As Long
            lcolumn = .UsedRange.Columns.Count
            
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(lproses, lcolumn))
            
                 With rng.Borders
                    .LineStyle = xlContinuous
                    .Color = vbBlack
                    .Weight = xlThin
                End With
            .Range("D1").value = "DT RUNNING"
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lcolumn)).Font.Bold = True
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lcolumn)).Interior.Color = RGB(0, 176, 240)
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lcolumn)).Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
            .Range(.Cells(1, 4), .Cells(1, lcolumn)).Merge
            .Range(.Cells(1, 4), .Cells(1, lcolumn)).ColumnWidth = 9
            .Rows(1).Insert
            .Columns(1).Insert
            
            Columns(2).NumberFormat = "dddd, mmmm d, yyyy"
            
           
            
'======================================================================================= Chart

    Sheets("Proses").Activate
    ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddChart2(297, xlColumnClustered).Select
    ActiveChart.Parent.Name = "DT Running"
    ActiveChart.SetSourceData Source:=Range("Proses!B2:D" & lproses + 1)
    ActiveChart.ClearToMatchStyle
    ActiveChart.ChartStyle = 304

    ActiveChart.PlotBy = xlColumns
    Selection.Format.TextFrame2.TextRange.Characters.Text = "DT RUNNING"

     ActiveChart.ChartTitle.Text = "DT RUNNING"
    ActiveChart.SetElement (msoElementDataLabelOutSideEnd)



      With .Shapes("DT Running")
    .LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
        .Height = 4.92 * 72
        .Width = 8.99 * 72
        .Placement = xlMove
        .LockAspectRatio = msoTrue
        
        
        .Top = 250
        .Left = 20
     
        ActiveSheet.Name = "DT RUNNING"
        Sheets("dbWB SMA").Delete
    End With
End With
      
        Else
        
        Exit Sub
        End If
    Else
        Exit Sub
End If
End Sub

Sub adt_running(control As IRibbonControl)

Dim lDPR As Long
Dim lproses As Integer
Dim DiffDate As Integer
Dim DateVariable
Dim DateVariable2
Dim j As Integer
Dim i As Integer
Dim lcolumn As Long

Dim lastcolumn As Integer


Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("ADT Running").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "ADT Running"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80




DateVariable = CalendarForm.getDate
If DateVariable <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "End Record"
        DateVariable2 = CalendarForm.getDate
        If DateVariable2 <> 0 Then
            
            
'========================================================== Block Open
open_dpr_hauling_monitor
'======================================================================
lDPR = Sheets("Hauling Monitor Tofu").Cells(Sheets("Hauling Monitor Tofu").Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
            
            DiffDate = DateVariable2 - DateVariable
            
            With Sheets("Hauling Monitor Tofu")
                j = 0
                
                For i = 0 To DiffDate
                .AutoFilterMode = False
                Date1 = Format(DateVariable + i, "d-mmm-yy")
                'Date2 = Format(DateVariable2, "dd-mmm-yy")
                .Range("A2:W" & lDPR).AutoFilter , Field:=1, Criteria1:=Date1
                .Range("A2:W" & lDPR).AutoFilter , Field:=2, Criteria1:=1
                '.Range("D1:D2").UnMerge
                .Range("C2:C" & lDPR).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
                Sheets("ADT Running").Cells(4, (j * 2) + 1).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
                
                Sheets("ADT Running").Cells(1, (i * 2) + 1).value = Date1
                Sheets("ADT Running").Cells(2, (i * 2) + 1).value = "DS"
                
                 .AutoFilterMode = False
                .Range("A2:W" & lDPR).AutoFilter , Field:=1, Criteria1:=Date1
                .Range("A2:W" & lDPR).AutoFilter , Field:=2, Criteria1:=2
                '.Range("D1:D2").UnMerge
                .Range("C2:C" & lDPR).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
                Sheets("ADT Running").Cells(4, (j * 2) + 2).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
                
                Sheets("ADT Running").Cells(1, (i * 2) + 2).value = Date1
                Sheets("ADT Running").Cells(2, (i * 2) + 2).value = "NS"
                .AutoFilterMode = False
                j = j + 1
                Next i
            End With
            Sheets("ADT Running").Activate
            With Sheets("ADT Running")
                lastcolumn = .Cells(1, Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
                    
                    For i = 1 To lastcolumn
                        lproses = .Cells(.Rows.Count, i).End(xlUp).Row
                        .Range(.Cells(4, i), .Cells(lproses, i)).RemoveDuplicates Columns:=Array(1), Header:=xlYes
                    Next i
                    

                     
                    For i = 1 To lastcolumn
                      
                        lproses = .Cells(.Rows.Count, i).End(xlUp).Row
                        .Cells(3, i).FormulaR1C1 = "=COUNTA(R[2]C" & i & ":R" & lproses & "C" & i & ")"

                    Next i
                        
                .UsedRange.Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeBlanks).Delete shift:=xlUp
                        
                .Range(.Cells(3, 1), .Cells(3, lastcolumn)).value = .Range(.Cells(3, 1), .Cells(3, lastcolumn)).value
                        
                        
            '==================================================================================== TRANSPOSE
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lastcolumn)).Copy
            .Cells(2, lastcolumn + 2).PasteSpecial Transpose:=True
            
            .Range(.Cells(2, 1), .Cells(2, lastcolumn)).Copy
            .Cells(2, lastcolumn + 3).PasteSpecial Transpose:=True
            
            .Range(.Cells(3, 1), .Cells(3, lastcolumn)).Copy
            .Cells(2, lastcolumn + 4).PasteSpecial Transpose:=True
            
                    For i = 1 To lastcolumn
                        lproses = .Cells(.Rows.Count, i).End(xlUp).Row
                        .Range(.Cells(5, i), .Cells(lproses, i)).Copy
                        .Cells(i + 1, lastcolumn + 5).PasteSpecial Transpose:=True
                        
                    Next i
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lastcolumn + 1)).EntireColumn.Delete
            
            '============================== Merge
            
            lproses = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
            
            For i = 1 To (lproses - 1) / 2
                .Range("A" & i * 2 & ":A" & (i * 2) + 1).Merge
            Next i
            
            
            .Range("A1").value = "Tanggal"
            .Range("B1").value = "Shift"
            .Range("C1").value = "Total"
            
            .UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
            .UsedRange.Columns.HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            .UsedRange.Columns.VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
            
          
            lcolumn = .UsedRange.Columns.Count
            
            Set rng = .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(lproses, lcolumn))
            
                 With rng.Borders
                    .LineStyle = xlContinuous
                    .Color = vbBlack
                    .Weight = xlThin
                End With
            .Range("D1").value = "ADT RUNNING"
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lcolumn)).Font.Bold = True
            .Range(.Cells(2, 4), .Cells(lproses, lcolumn)).Replace "ADT ", ""
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lcolumn)).Interior.Color = RGB(198, 89, 17)
            .Range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, lcolumn)).Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
            .Range(.Cells(1, 4), .Cells(1, lcolumn)).Merge
            .Range(.Cells(1, 4), .Cells(1, lcolumn)).ColumnWidth = 9
            .Rows(1).Insert
            .Columns(1).Insert
            
            .Columns(2).NumberFormat = "dddd, mmmm d, yyyy"
            
           
            
'======================================================================================= Chart
     
     
     .Shapes.AddChart2(297, xlColumnClustered).Select
     
    With ActiveChart
    
    .Parent.Name = "ADT Running"
    .SetSourceData Source:=Range("'ADT Running'!B3:D" & lproses + 1)
    .ClearToMatchStyle
    .ChartStyle = 304

    .PlotBy = xlColumns
    Selection.Format.TextFrame2.TextRange.Characters.Text = "Hauling"
    
  
    .SeriesCollection(1).Interior.Color = RGB(237, 125, 49)
   
   
    .HasTitle = True
    .SetElement (msoElementDataLabelOutSideEnd)
    .ChartTitle.Text = "ADT RUNNING"

    .ChartTitle.Format.TextFrame2.TextRange.Font.Size = 20
    .ChartTitle.Format.TextFrame2.TextRange.Font.Bold = msoCTrue
    End With
    
      With .Shapes("ADT Running")
    .LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
        .Height = 4.92 * 72
        .Width = 8.99 * 72
        .Placement = xlMove
        .LockAspectRatio = msoTrue
        
        
        .Top = 250
        .Left = 20
     
        
    End With
    
Sheets("Hauling Monitor Tofu").Delete
End With

        Else
        
        Exit Sub
        End If
    Else
        Exit Sub
End If


End Sub

VBA MACRO MR_DPR_fuel.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/MR_DPR_fuel'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

Sub dpr_fuel(control As IRibbonControl)
Dim SourceWb As Workbook
Dim lDPR As Long
Dim lcheck As Integer
Dim lcheckDpr As Integer
Dim lcheckFuel As Integer

Dim lFuel As Integer

Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("Check").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "Check"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80

lDPR = Sheets("Fuel").Cells(Sheets("Fuel").Rows.Count, "B").End(xlUp).Row

DateVariable = CalendarForm.getDate
If DateVariable <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "End Record"
        DateVariable2 = CalendarForm.getDate
        If DateVariable2 <> 0 Then
            With Sheets("Fuel")
                Date1 = Format(DateVariable, "dd-mmm-yy")
                Date2 = Format(DateVariable2, "dd-mmm-yy")
                
                .AutoFilterMode = False
                .Range("B3:B" & lDPR).AutoFilter , Field:=1, Criteria1:= _
          ">=" & Date1, Operator:=xlAnd, Criteria2:="<=" & Date2
                .Range("D4:D" & lDPR).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
                 Sheets("Check").Cells(1, 2).value = "From DPR"
                Sheets("Check").Cells(2, 2).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
'                .AutoFilterMode = False
            End With
      
            Set actWB = ActiveWorkbook
            nameFile = Application.GetOpenFilename()
            
            On Error Resume Next
            Application.DisplayAlerts = False
            Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False
            Set SourceWb = Workbooks.Open(FileName:=nameFile, ReadOnly:=False)
            Application.DisplayAlerts = True
            Application.AskToUpdateLinks = True
            On Error GoTo 0
            If SourceWb Is Nothing Then
                Exit Sub
            Else
                Application.DisplayAlerts = False
                With SourceWb.Sheets("Fuel by Equipment")
                    lFuel = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "C").End(xlUp).Row
                    .Range("C5:C" & lFuel).Copy
                    actWB.Sheets("Check").Cells(1, 1).value = "From Fuel"
                    actWB.Sheets("Check").Cells(2, 1).PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
                End With
                
                SourceWb.Close
            End If
            
            
            With Sheets("Check")
                
                On Error Resume Next
                lcheckFuel = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
                .Range("A1:A" & lcheckFuel).Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeBlanks).EntireRow.Delete
            
                On Error GoTo 0
                
                lcheckDpr = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "B").End(xlUp).Row
                .Range("B1:B" & lcheckDpr).RemoveDuplicates Columns:=Array(1), Header:=xlYes
                
                lcheckFuel = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
                
                .Range("C1").value = "Check"
                 lcheckDpr = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "B").End(xlUp).Row
                For i = 2 To lcheckDpr
                    .Cells(i, 3).FormulaR1C1 = "=IFNA(MATCH(RC[-1],R2C1:R" & lcheckFuel & "C1,0),0)"
                Next i
                
                lcheck = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "C").End(xlUp).Row
                .Range("C1:C" & lcheck).AutoFilter , Field:=1, Criteria1:=0


            End With
            
            
        Else
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Else
        Exit Sub
End If
End Sub



Sub fix_fuel(control As IRibbonControl)
Dim lcheckFuel As Integer

    With Sheets("Check")
        lcheckFuel = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
        lcheckDpr = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "B").End(xlUp).Row
        lcheck = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "C").End(xlUp).Row

        .Range("B1:C" & lcheck).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
        .AutoFilterMode = False
        .Range("E1").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
    End With
    
    
    lDPR = Sheets("Fuel").Cells(Sheets("Fuel").Rows.Count, "B").End(xlUp).Row
    fdpr = Sheets("Fuel").Range("B4:B" & Sheets("Fuel").Rows.Count).SpecialCells(xlVisible)(1).Row
    
    With Sheets("Check")
    Dim lfix As Integer
    lfix = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "E").End(xlUp).Row
    
    For i = 2 To lfix
         Sheets("Fuel").Range("D" & fdpr & ":D" & lDPR).Replace .Cells(i, 5).value, .Cells(i, 6).value, MatchCase:=True, LookAt:=xlWhole
        
    Next i
    End With
End Sub


Sub daily_fuel(control As IRibbonControl)

Dim DateVariable2

Dim i As Integer

On Error GoTo 0

Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "Copy Fuel"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80




DateVariable = CalendarForm.getDate
If DateVariable <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "End Record"
        DateVariable2 = CalendarForm.getDate
        If DateVariable2 <> 0 Then
        

lResult = Sheets("RESULT").Cells(Sheets("RESULT").Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

            DiffDate = DateVariable2 - DateVariable
            With Sheets("RESULT")
              
            
                
                Date1 = Format(DateVariable, "dd-mmm-yy")
                Date2 = Format(DateVariable2, "dd-mmm-yy")
                
                .AutoFilterMode = False
                .Range("A8:Q" & lResult).AutoFilter , Field:=1, Criteria1:= _
                ">=" & Date1, Operator:=xlAnd, Criteria2:="<=" & Date2
                .Range("A8:Q" & lResult).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
                Sheets("Copy Fuel").Cells(1, 1).PasteSpecial Paste:=xlPasteValues
                Application.CutCopyMode = False
                .AutoFilterMode = False
            End With
            
            With Sheets("Copy Fuel")
                ldataFuel = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
                
                .Columns("N:Q").Delete
                .Columns("K:L").Delete
                .Columns("E:G").Delete
                .Columns("C").Delete
                
                .Columns("C").Cut
                .Columns("B").Insert shift:=xlToRight
                
                .Columns("E").Cut
                .Columns("C").Insert shift:=xlToRight
                
                .Columns("F").Cut
                .Columns("E").Insert shift:=xlToRight
                
                .Columns("E").Insert shift:=xlToRight
                .Columns("E").Insert shift:=xlToRight
                .Columns("E").Insert shift:=xlToRight
                
                .Columns("I").Insert shift:=xlToRight
                
                .Columns("K").Insert shift:=xlToRight
                .Columns("K").Insert shift:=xlToRight
                .Columns("K").Insert shift:=xlToRight
                .Columns("K").Insert shift:=xlToRight
                
                .Range("I2:I" & ldataFuel).value = "Refuel"
                
                .Range("C2:C" & ldataFuel).Replace "-", " ", MatchCase:=False, LookAt:=xlPart
                .Range("D2:D" & ldataFuel).Replace "DF", 1, MatchCase:=True, LookAt:=xlWhole
                .Range("D2:D" & ldataFuel).Replace "NF", 2, MatchCase:=True, LookAt:=xlWhole
                
                .Columns(1).NumberFormat = "d-mmm-yy"
                .Columns(2).NumberFormat = "d-mmm-yy"

            End With
      
        Else
        
        Exit Sub
        End If
    Else
        Exit Sub
End If
