VBA MACRO QC_daily_Report.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/QC_daily_Report'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Sub qc_report(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim wsSource As Worksheet
    Dim wsResult As Worksheet
    Dim iCol As Long, iRow As Long
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim outRow As Long
    Dim rng As Range
    Dim BlockID As String, RITValue As Variant, Material As String, TFValue As Variant
    Dim Dome As Variant, Status As Variant, Destination As Variant
    Dim SubPit As Variant, ProdID As String
    Dim Contractor As String, Activity As String
    Dim val As String
    Dim ReportDate As Variant, ShiftInfo As Variant, ShiftNum As Variant
    Dim isBMEmpty As Boolean
    Dim RawMaterial As String
    Dim parts As Variant, d As Variant
    Dim Block_type As String

    Set wsSource = ActiveSheet

    ' ==== 1. Unmerge header baris 6 ====
    With wsSource
        For iCol = 17 To 55
            If .Cells(6, iCol).MergeCells Then
                Set rng = .Cells(6, iCol).MergeArea
                val = rng.Cells(1, 1).value
                rng.UnMerge
                rng.value = val
            End If
        Next iCol

        .Columns("BE:BJ").Delete
        .Columns("Q:Q").Delete
    End With

    ' ==== 2. Siapkan Sheet Hasil ====
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Worksheets("Result").Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    On Error GoTo 0

    Set wsResult = Worksheets.Add
    wsResult.Name = "Result"

    wsResult.Range("A1:R1").value = Array( _
        "CONTRACTOR", "DATE", "SHIFT", "ACTIVITY", "PIT", "SUBPIT", "BLOCK_TYPE", "BLOCK_STATUS", _
        "BLOCK ID", "PROD_ID", "MATERIAL", "RIT", "TF", "WMT", "DESTINATION", "DOME", "TOS_PILE", "" _
    )

    outRow = 2

    ReportDate = wsSource.Cells(2, 61).value
    ShiftInfo = Trim(UCase(wsSource.Cells(3, 61).value))

    Select Case ShiftInfo
        Case "DAY SHIFT": ShiftNum = 1
        Case "NIGHT SHIFT": ShiftNum = 2
        Case Else: ShiftNum = ""
    End Select

    lastRow = wsSource.Cells(wsSource.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

    For iRow = 5 To lastRow
        BlockID = wsSource.Cells(iRow, 4).value
        If BlockID <> "" Then
            Destination = wsSource.Cells(iRow, 57).value
            Dome = wsSource.Cells(iRow, 60).value
            Status = wsSource.Cells(iRow, 61).value
            SubPit = wsSource.Cells(iRow, 3).value
            Block_type = "BLOCK"
            ProdID = BlockID & wsSource.Cells(iRow, 5).value
            Contractor = "SMA"
            isBMEmpty = Trim(wsSource.Cells(iRow, 8).value) = ""

            Activity = "TF"
            Material = ""

            If isBMEmpty Then
                Activity = "LAMINATING"
                Material = "LAMINATING"
            Else
                Activity = "MINING"
                Block_type = "LAMINATING"
            End If

            For iCol = 17 To 55
                RITValue = wsSource.Cells(iRow, iCol).value
                If RITValue <> "" And IsNumeric(RITValue) Then
                    RawMaterial = wsSource.Cells(6, iCol).value
                    TFValue = wsSource.Cells(8, iCol).value

                    If Trim(UCase(RawMaterial)) <> "RITASE AKTUAL" Then
                        If Not isBMEmpty Then
                            Material = RawMaterial
                        End If

                        If (IsNumeric(wsSource.Cells(iRow, 35).value) And wsSource.Cells(iRow, 35).value <> 0) Or _
                           (IsNumeric(wsSource.Cells(iRow, 36).value) And wsSource.Cells(iRow, 36).value <> 0) Or _
                           (IsNumeric(wsSource.Cells(iRow, 37).value) And wsSource.Cells(iRow, 37).value <> 0) Then
                            ProdID = "Waste Boulder"
                        End If

                        ' === Transform Material Name ===
                        Select Case UCase(Material)
                            Case "SAPROLITE": Material = "SAP"
                            Case "LIMONITE": Material = "LIM"
                            Case "QUARRY": Material = "QRY"
                            Case "TOP SOIL": Material = "TS"
                            Case "BIOMAS": Material = "BIO"
                            Case "BOULDER": Material = "BLD"
                            Case "LAMINATING": Material = "LJ"
                            Case "WASTE": Material = "WST"
                        End Select

                        ' === Transform TF Value ===
                        If TFValue = 60 Then TFValue = 47
                        If TFValue = 40 Then TFValue = 30

                        ' === Tulis hasil ===
                        With wsResult
                            .Cells(outRow, 1).value = Contractor
                            .Cells(outRow, 2).value = ReportDate
                            .Cells(outRow, 3).value = ShiftNum
                            .Cells(outRow, 4).value = Activity
                            .Cells(outRow, 5).value = "TF"
                            .Cells(outRow, 6).value = SubPit
                            .Cells(outRow, 7).value = Block_type
                            .Cells(outRow, 8).value = Status
                            .Cells(outRow, 9).value = BlockID
                            .Cells(outRow, 10).value = ProdID
                            .Cells(outRow, 11).value = Material
                            .Cells(outRow, 12).value = RITValue
                            .Cells(outRow, 13).value = TFValue
                            .Cells(outRow, 14).FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-1]*RC[-2]"
                            .Cells(outRow, 15).value = Destination
                            .Cells(outRow, 16).value = Dome

                            If InStr(1, .Cells(outRow, 13).value, ";") > 0 Then
                                parts = Split(.Cells(outRow, 13).value, ";")
                                For Each d In parts
                                    d = Trim(d)
                                    If UCase(.Cells(outRow, 9).value) = "SAPROLITE" And Left(d, 3) = "TOS" Then
                                        .Cells(outRow, 13).value = d
                                        Exit For
                                    ElseIf UCase(.Cells(outRow, 9).value) = "LIMONITE" And Left(d, 2) = "LD" Then
                                        .Cells(outRow, 13).value = d
                                        Exit For
                                    End If
                                Next d
                            End If
                        End With

                        outRow = outRow + 1
                    End If
                End If
            Next iCol
        End If
    Next iRow

    ' ==== 3. Post-processing untuk penyesuaian tambahan ====
    Dim finalRow As Long
    finalRow = wsResult.Cells(wsResult.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

    For iRow = 2 To finalRow
        With wsResult
            ' Kolom K - Material normalisasi
            If .Cells(iRow, 11).value = "LJ" Or .Cells(iRow, 11).value = "QRY" Then
                .Cells(iRow, 11).value = "WST"
            End If

            ' Kolom H (8) - Status cleanup
            Dim v As Variant
            v = .Cells(iRow, 8).value
            If Not IsError(v) Then
                v = Replace(v, Chr(160), " ")
                v = WorksheetFunction.Trim(WorksheetFunction.Clean(v))
                If UCase$(v) = "CLOSE BLOCK" Then v = "CLOSE"
                If InStr(v, " ") > 0 Then v = ""
                .Cells(iRow, 8).value = v
            End If

            ' Kolom F (6) - Hapus spasi tengah
            Dim v6 As Variant
            v6 = .Cells(iRow, 6).value
            If Not IsError(v6) Then
                v6 = CStr(v6)
                v6 = Replace(v6, Chr(160), " ")
                v6 = WorksheetFunction.Clean(v6)
                v6 = Trim(v6)
                v6 = Replace(v6, " ", "")
                v6 = Replace(v6, vbTab, "")
                .Cells(iRow, 6).value = v6
            End If

            ' Kolom K (11) - Material cleanup
            Dim v11 As Variant
            v11 = .Cells(iRow, 11).value
            If Not IsError(v11) Then
                v11 = CStr(v11)
                v11 = Replace(v11, Chr(160), " ")
                v11 = WorksheetFunction.Clean(v11)
                v11 = Trim(v11)
                If InStr(v11, " ") > 0 Then v11 = Replace(v11, " ", "")
                v11 = UCase$(v11)
                If v11 = "LJ" Or v11 = "QRY" Then v11 = "WST"
                .Cells(iRow, 11).value = v11
            End If

            ' Block Type mengikuti Activity
            If .Cells(iRow, 4).value = "MINING" Then
                .Cells(iRow, 7).value = "BLOCK"
            ElseIf .Cells(iRow, 4).value = "LAMINATING" Then
                .Cells(iRow, 7).value = "LAMINATING"
            End If

            ' Topsoil exception
            If InStr(1, UCase(.Cells(iRow, 9).value), "TOPSOIL") > 0 Then
                .Cells(iRow, 7).value = "TOPSOIL"
                .Cells(iRow, 11).value = "TS"
            End If

            ' --- Jangan hapus Dome untuk SAP & LIM ---
            If (.Cells(iRow, 11).value <> "SAP" And .Cells(iRow, 11).value <> "LIM") _
               And .Cells(iRow, 16).value <> "" Then
                .Cells(iRow, 16).value = ""
            End If

            ' ---------- Filter kolom DESTINATION + prefer TOS_TF_ utk SAP & LIM ----------
            Dim destParts As Variant, resultDest As String, part As Variant
            Dim currMaterial As String
            Dim originalDest As String, originalDome As String
            Dim foundToken As Boolean

            originalDest = .Cells(iRow, 15).value  ' simpan nilai asal P
            originalDome = .Cells(iRow, 16).value  ' simpan nilai asal Q
            resultDest = originalDest              ' default: pakai nilai asal
            foundToken = False
            currMaterial = .Cells(iRow, 11).value

            ' Reset Dome hanya jika BUKAN SAP/LIM
            If currMaterial <> "SAP" And currMaterial <> "LIM" Then
                .Cells(iRow, 16).value = ""
            End If

            destParts = Split(originalDest, ";")

            For Each part In destParts
                part = Trim(part)

                Select Case currMaterial

                    ' SAP & LIM sama: pilih yang mengandung TOS_TF_
                    Case "SAP", "LIM"
                        If InStr(1, part, "TOS_TF_", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                            resultDest = part
                            foundToken = True
                            Exit For
                        End If

                    Case Else
                        ' material lain: pilih part pertama yang bukan TOS_TF_/LD_TF_
                        If InStr(1, part, "TOS_TF_", vbTextCompare) = 0 And _
                           InStr(1, part, "LD_TF_", vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
                            resultDest = part
                            foundToken = True
                            Exit For
                        End If
                End Select
            Next part

            ' Tulis kembali Destination & Dome:
            If foundToken Then
                .Cells(iRow, 15).value = resultDest
                ' (Dome utk SAP/LIM dibiarkan nilainya; jika butuh ekstraksi dari part, bisa ditambah di sini)
            Else
                ' Tidak ada kandidat khusus -> biarkan nilai asal (hindari P kosong)
                .Cells(iRow, 15).value = originalDest
                .Cells(iRow, 16).value = originalDome
            End If
            ' --------------------------------------------------------------------------

            ' === SPOIL override (PASTI TERAKHIR): jika kolom I mengandung "SPOIL" set kolom G = "SPOIL" ===
            Dim blkId As String
            blkId = CStr(.Cells(iRow, 9).value)  ' kolom I
            If InStr(1, blkId, "SPOIL", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                .Cells(iRow, 7).value = "SPOIL"  ' kolom G
            End If
            ' =================================================================================================

        End With
    Next iRow

    wsResult.Cells(1, 19).value = "SORT_KEY"

    For iRow = 2 To finalRow
        Dim mat As String: mat = wsResult.Cells(iRow, 11).value
        Dim tf As Variant: tf = wsResult.Cells(iRow, 13).value
        Dim sortKey As Integer

        Select Case mat
            Case "SAP": sortKey = IIf(tf = 47, 1, 2)
            Case "LIM": sortKey = IIf(tf = 47, 3, 4)
            Case "WST": sortKey = IIf(tf = 47, 5, 6)
            Case Else: sortKey = 99
        End Select

        wsResult.Cells(iRow, 19).value = sortKey
    Next iRow

    With wsResult.Sort
        .SortFields.Clear
        .SortFields.Add2 key:=wsResult.Range("S2:S" & finalRow), SortOn:=xlSortOnValues, Order:=xlAscending, DataOption:=xlSortNormal
        .SetRange wsResult.Range("A1:S" & finalRow)
        .Header = xlYes
        .Apply
    End With

    wsResult.Columns("S").ClearContents

    With wsResult
        .Columns("L:L").Insert shift:=xlToRight
        .Cells(1, 12).value = "MATERIAL_CLASS"

        Dim i As Long
        For i = 2 To finalRow
            If .Cells(i, 11).value = "WASTELIM" Then
                .Cells(i, 12).value = "WST LIM"
            ElseIf .Cells(i, 11).value = "WASTESAP" Then
                .Cells(i, 12).value = "WST SAP"
            ElseIf .Cells(i, 11).value = "WASTEBRK" Then
                .Cells(i, 12).value = "WST BRK"
            End If
        Next i

        For i = 2 To finalRow
            If .Cells(i, 12).value = "WST LIM" Or .Cells(i, 12).value = "WST SAP" Or .Cells(i, 12).value = "WST BRK" Then
                .Cells(i, 11).value = "WST"
            End If
        Next i

        For i = 2 To finalRow
            If .Cells(i, 7).value = "TOPSOIL" Then
                .Cells(i, 4).value = "MINING"
            End If
        Next i
    End With
End Sub

On Error GoTo 0

    .Columns("O").Replace What:="QRY", Replacement:="WST", _
        SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, MatchCase:=True
     .Columns("O").Replace What:="BD", Replacement:="WST", _
        SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, MatchCase:=True
    
    .Range("Q2:Q" & lRSummaryNS).value = .Range("Q2:Q" & lRSummaryNS).value
    
    .Columns("Q").Replace What:="Road Permanent KR", Replacement:="INPIT", _
        SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, MatchCase:=True
    .Columns("Q").Replace What:="FALSE", Replacement:="WD", _
        SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, MatchCase:=True


'delete 0

    For i = 2 To lRSummaryNS
        If .Cells(i, 14).value = 0 Then
        
            .Range(.Cells(i, 14), .Cells(i, 17)).ClearContents
        
        End If
    Next i
    

    
'delete 07 - 08

    For i = 2 To lRSummaryNS
        If .Cells(i, 5).value = "07" Then
        
            .Range(.Cells(i, 1), .Cells(i, 17)).EntireRow.Delete
        
        End If
    Next i

End With

    lRSummaryDS = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "O").End(xlUp).Row

        SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, MatchCase:=True
     .Columns("O").Replace What:="BD", Replacement:="WST", _

    .Columns("Q").Replace What:="Road Permanent KR", Replacement:="INPIT", _
        SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, MatchCase:=True
    .Columns("Q").Replace What:="FALSE", Replacement:="WD", _
        SearchOrder:=xlByColumns, MatchCase:=True
        
    'delete 0

    For i = 2 To lRSummaryDS
        If .Cells(i, 14).value = 0 Then
        
            .Range(.Cells(i, 14), .Cells(i, 17)).ClearContents
        
        End If
    Next i

    
    
    
    'delete 19 - 20

Sub combine_pdb()

lSumDs = Sheets("SummaryDS").Range("A" & Sheets("SummaryDS").Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
lSumNs = Sheets("SummaryNS").Range("A" & Sheets("SummaryNS").Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row

On Error Resume Next

Sheets("SummaryNS").Range("A2:A" & lSumNs).Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeBlanks).EntireRow.Delete

Sheets("SummaryDS").Range("N2:N" & lSumDs).Replace " ", "-", xlPart, xlByRows, False, False, False, False
Sheets("SummaryNS").Range("N2:N" & lSumNs).Replace " ", "-", xlPart, xlByRows, False, False, False, False

Sheets("SummaryNS").Range("A2:S" & lPDB).Copy
Sheets("PDB").Range("A" & lPDB + 1).PasteSpecial
End Sub



Sub ReplaceLaminatin()


    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim cell As Range
    Dim rng As Range

    Set ws = Sheets("SummaryDS")
    Set rng = ws.UsedRange

    For Each cell In rng
        If Not IsError(cell.value) Then
            If InStr(1, cell.value, "LAMINATIN", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                cell.value = Replace(cell.value, "LAMINATIN", "LAMINATING")
            End If
        End If
    Next cell
    
    Set ws = Sheets("SummaryNS")
    Set rng = ws.UsedRange

    For Each cell In rng
        If Not IsError(cell.value) Then
            If InStr(1, cell.value, "LAMINATIN", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                cell.value = Replace(cell.value, "LAMINATIN", "LAMINATING")
            End If
        End If
    Next cell



End Sub


Sub ReplaceSpoi()


    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim cell As Range
    Dim rng As Range

    Set ws = Sheets("SummaryDS")
    Set rng = ws.UsedRange

    For Each cell In rng
        If Not IsError(cell.value) Then
            If InStr(1, cell.value, "SPOI", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                cell.value = Replace(cell.value, "SPOI", "SPOIL")
            End If
        End If
    Next cell
    
    Set ws = Sheets("SummaryNS")
    Set rng = ws.UsedRange

    For Each cell In rng
        If Not IsError(cell.value) Then
            If InStr(1, cell.value, "SPOI", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                cell.value = Replace(cell.value, "SPOI", "SPOIL")
            End If
        End If
    Next cell



End Sub

Sub sync_qc_room_NS()

Sheets("sync").UsedRange.ClearContents

Dim lroomNS As Integer
Dim lQcNS As Integer

lroomNS = Sheets("SummaryNS").Cells(Sheets("SummaryNS").Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
lQcNS = Sheets("dataQcNS").Cells(Sheets("dataQcNS").Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
'================================================================================================ NS
'================================= LIMONITE 30
'room
Sheets("SummaryNS").AutoFilterMode = False
Sheets("SummaryNS").Range("A1:S" & lroomNS).AutoFilter , Field:=13, Criteria1:=30
Sheets("SummaryNS").Range("A1:S" & lroomNS).AutoFilter , Field:=15, Criteria1:="LIM"
Sheets("SummaryNS").Range("P1:P" & lroomNS).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).Copy
Sheets("sync").Cells(1, 15).PasteSpecial
'QC

Sub proses_room_qc_ds()

With Sheets("sync")

Dim lsyncRoom As Integer
Dim lsyncQC As Integer
Dim lritColRoom As Integer
Dim lRit As Integer
Dim i As Integer
Dim j As Integer
Dim iCol As Integer

lsyncRoom = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "O").End(xlUp).Row
lsyncQC = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "D").End(xlUp).Row

If lsyncRoom > 1 Then

For i = 2 To lsyncQC 'lsyncQc

    .Cells(2, 16).FormulaR1C1 = "=SumSolver(R" & i & "C4,R2C15:R" & lsyncRoom & "C15)"
    .Cells(2, 16).value = .Cells(2, 16).value
    .Cells(2, 16).TextToColumns DataType:=xlDelimited, Comma:=True
    
    lritColRoom = .Cells(2, Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    
    .Range(.Cells(2, 16), .Cells(2, lritColRoom)).Copy
    .Cells(3, 16).PasteSpecial Transpose:=True
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    .Range(.Cells(2, 16), .Cells(2, lritColRoom)).ClearContents
    
    lRit = .Cells(.Rows.Count, "p").End(xlUp).Row
    On Error Resume Next
    If lRit > 3 Then
    .Range("P3:P" & lRit).Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeBlanks).Delete shift:=xlUp
    End If
    
        For j = 3 To lRit
        .Cells(j, 17).FormulaR1C1 = "=MATCH(RC[-1],R1C15:R" & lsyncRoom & "C15,FALSE)"
        .Cells(j, 17).value = .Cells(j, 17).value
        
        Dim a As Integer
        a = .Cells(j, 17).value
        
        .Cells(a, 10).value = .Cells(i, 3).value
        .Cells(a, 11).value = .Cells(i, 8).value
        .Cells(a, 12).value = .Cells(i, 7).value
        .Cells(a, 15).ClearContents
        Next j
    .Range("P3:Q" & lRit).ClearContents
Next i

'=================================================== Copy to PDB NS
    Dim rng1 As Range
    Dim rng2 As Range
    Dim InputRng As Range
    Dim OutRng As Range
    Dim lrSync As Integer
    Dim lrPdb As Integer
    Dim frPdb As Integer
    
   With Worksheets("SummaryDS").AutoFilter.Range
       frPdb = .Range("A" & .Offset(1, 0).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible)(1).Row).Row
       lrPdb = .Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    End With
    
    lrSync = .Range("J" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    
    '==================== ProdID ID
    Set InputRng = .Range("J2:J" & lrSync)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("SummaryDS").Range("J" & frPdb & ":J" & lrPdb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    
    
    '==================== Destination
    'If .Range("F2") <> "WASTE" Then
    Set InputRng = .Range("K2:K" & lrSync)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("SummaryDS").Range("Q" & frPdb & ":Q" & lrPdb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    
      '==================== Pile ID
    Set InputRng = .Range("L2:L" & lrSync)
    Set OutRng = Sheets("SummaryDS").Range("R" & frPdb & ":R" & lrPdb)
    For Each rng1 In InputRng
        rng1.Copy
        For Each rng2 In OutRng
            If rng2.EntireRow.RowHeight > 0 Then
                rng2.PasteSpecial
                Set OutRng = rng2.Offset(1).Resize(OutRng.Rows.Count)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    
    'End If
End If
End With

Sheets("SummaryDS").AutoFilterMode = False
Sheets("dataQCDS").AutoFilterMode = False

End Sub

Sub trim_tos_dome()

On Error Resume Next
Dim r As Range

    With Application.WorksheetFunction
    For Each r In Intersect(Selection, Sheets("SummaryDS").UsedRange)
        r.value = .Trim(r.value)
    Next r
    
     For Each r In Intersect(Selection, Sheets("SummaryDS").UsedRange)
        r.value = .Trim(r.value)
    Next r
    End With
End Sub

lastsheet = actWB.Sheets.Count

On Error Resume Next
Sheets("dataQcDS").Delete
Sheets("QCDS").Delete

Exit Sub
Else

Sub summary_QC_NS_all()

Dim nameFile As String
Dim SourceWb As Workbook
Dim actWB As Workbook
Dim lastsheet As Integer

MsgBox "Open QC NS"

nameFile = Application.GetOpenFilename()
Set actWB = ActiveWorkbook
lastsheet = actWB.Sheets.Count

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
On Error Resume Next
Sheets("dataQcNS").Delete
Sheets("QCNS").Delete
Sheets("sync").Delete
On Error GoTo 0

Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False



Application.DisplayAlerts = True
Application.AskToUpdateLinks = True
On Error Resume Next
Set SourceWb = Workbooks.Open(FileName:=nameFile, ReadOnly:=False)
On Error GoTo 0

If SourceWb Is Nothing Then
Exit Sub
Else
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
lastsheet = actWB.Sheets.Count

SourceWb.Sheets(1).Copy After:=actWB.Sheets(lastsheet)
    
 lastsheet = actWB.Sheets.Count
    actWB.Sheets(lastsheet).AutoFilterMode = False
    actWB.Sheets(lastsheet).Visible = True
    actWB.Sheets(lastsheet).Name = "QCNS"
    SourceWb.Close

Sheets.Add After:=Sheets(Sheets.Count)
Sheets(Sheets.Count).Name = "dataQCNS"
ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80

    .Columns("E").Delete
    .Columns("H:P").Delete

Sub delete_non_t0s_lmd_ds()

Dim lc As Integer
Dim lr As Long
Dim myString As String

With Sheets("dataQcDS")
 
lc = .Cells(2, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
lr = .Cells(Rows.Count, "E").End(xlUp).Row

'=========================================================================== Saprolite
For i = 2 To lr

    If .Cells(i, 6).value = "SAPROLITE" Then
        lc = .Cells(i, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
        For j = lc To 8 Step -1
            myString = Trim(Cells(i, j).value)
             If InStr(myString, "TOS") = 0 Then
                .Cells(i, j).Delete shift:=xlToLeft
             End If
        
        Next j
    End If
Next i


'=========================================================================== Limonite
For i = 2 To lr

    If .Cells(i, 6).value = "LIMONITE" Then
        lc = .Cells(i, .Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
        For j = lc To 8 Step -1
            myString = Trim(Cells(i, j).value)
             If InStr(myString, "TOS") = 0 Then
                .Cells(i, j).Delete shift:=xlToLeft
             End If
        
        Next j
    End If
Next i



End With


End Sub

Sub DeleteRows_ColC_Contains_LAMINATING_or_SPOIL_DS()
    Dim ws As Worksheet, rg As Range
    Set ws = Sheets("dataQcDS")
    If ws.UsedRange.Cells.Count = 1 And IsEmpty(ws.UsedRange) Then Exit Sub

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Set rg = ws.UsedRange                ' atau ws.Range("A1").CurrentRegion bila data rapat

    ' Pastikan tidak ada filter aktif dulu
    If ws.AutoFilterMode Then ws.AutoFilter.ShowAllData

    ' Filter kolom C untuk yang MENGANDUNG kata
    rg.AutoFilter Field:=3, Criteria1:="=*LAMINATING*", Operator:=xlOr, Criteria2:="=*SPOIL*"

    ' Hapus baris hasil filter (kecuali header)
    On Error Resume Next
    rg.Offset(1).Resize(rg.Rows.Count - 1).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).EntireRow.Delete
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' Bersihkan filter
    ws.AutoFilterMode = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub




Sub DeleteRows_ColC_Contains_LAMINATING_or_SPOIL_NS()
    Dim ws As Worksheet, rg As Range
    Set ws = Sheets("dataQcNS")
    If ws.UsedRange.Cells.Count = 1 And IsEmpty(ws.UsedRange) Then Exit Sub

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Set rg = ws.UsedRange                ' atau ws.Range("A1").CurrentRegion bila data rapat

    ' Pastikan tidak ada filter aktif dulu
    If ws.AutoFilterMode Then ws.AutoFilter.ShowAllData

    ' Filter kolom C untuk yang MENGANDUNG kata
    rg.AutoFilter Field:=3, Criteria1:="=*LAMINATING*", Operator:=xlOr, Criteria2:="=*SPOIL*"

    ' Hapus baris hasil filter (kecuali header)
    On Error Resume Next
    rg.Offset(1).Resize(rg.Rows.Count - 1).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible).EntireRow.Delete
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' Bersihkan filter
    ws.AutoFilterMode = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub

VBA MACRO daily_wb_iwip.bas 
in file: x1/xl/vbaProject.bin - OLE stream: 'VBA/daily_wb_iwip'
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Sub convert_wb_iwip(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim lastCol As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim c As Long
    Dim d As Range
    
    Set ws = ActiveSheet   ' bekerja di sheet aktif
    
    '==========
    ' 1. Hapus semua baris yang kolom J-nya ? "SMA"
    '==========
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "J").End(xlUp).Row
    
    ' Asumsi baris 1 adalah header
    For i = lastRow To 2 Step -1
        If ws.Cells(i, "J").value <> "SMA" Then
            ws.Rows(i).Delete
        End If
    
    Next i
    
    '==========
    ' 2. Hapus semua kolom kecuali E, G, L, O, P, Q, R, S
    '   (E=5, G=7, L=12, O=15, P=16, Q=17, R=18, S=19)
    '==========
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    
    For c = lastCol To 1 Step -1
        Select Case c
            Case 5, 7, 10, 12, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 25
                ' kolom yang DIPERTAHANKAN: E, G, L, O, P, Q, R, S
            Case Else
                ws.Columns(c).Delete
        End Select
    Next c
    
    
    
    'Switch Kolom
    
    
    With ActiveSheet

        .Columns("B").Cut
        .Columns("A").Insert shift:=xlToRight
        
        
        .Columns("J").Cut
        .Columns("R").Insert shift:=xlToRight
        
        .Columns("I").Cut
        .Columns("N").Insert shift:=xlToRight
        
        .Columns("H").Cut
        .Columns("M").Insert shift:=xlToRight
        
        
        
   
        
        .Columns("G").Cut
        .Columns("L").Insert shift:=xlToRight
        
        .Columns("F").Cut
        .Columns("K").Insert shift:=xlToRight
        
        .Columns("E").Cut
        .Columns("J").Insert shift:=xlToRight
        
        .Columns("D").Cut
        .Columns("I").Insert shift:=xlToRight
        
           
        .Columns("C").Cut
        .Columns("G").Insert shift:=xlToRight
        
        .Columns("B").Cut
        .Columns("E").Insert shift:=xlToRight


         With .Columns("C")
        .Replace What:="SM", _
                 Replacement:="", _
                 LookAt:=xlPart, _
                 SearchOrder:=xlByRows, _
                 MatchCase:=False
        End With
        
         
         
        
         lastRow = .Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "H").End(xlUp).Row

            For Each d In ws.Range("H2:H" & lastRow)
                If Len(d.value) > 0 Then
                    pos = InStr(1, d.value, "-")
                    If pos > 0 Then
                        d.value = Left$(d.value, pos - 1)
                    End If
                End If
            Next d
            
            
             Dim dt As Date

         Set ws = ActiveSheet

    ' Cari baris terakhir di kolom L dan M
    lastRowL = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "L").End(xlUp).Row
    lastRowM = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "M").End(xlUp).Row
    lastRow = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(lastRowL, lastRowM)

    ' Loop dari baris 2 (anggap baris 1 header)
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        ' === TANGGAL: dari kolom L ke kolom N ===
        If IsDate(ws.Cells(i, "L").value) Then
            dt = CDate(ws.Cells(i, "L").value)
            ws.Cells(i, "N").value = Int(dt)      'tanggal saja
        Else
            ' optional: kosongkan kalau bukan tanggal
            ' ws.Cells(i, "N").Value = ""
        End If

        ' === JAM: dari kolom M ke kolom p ===
        If IsDate(ws.Cells(i, "M").value) Then
            dt = CDate(ws.Cells(i, "M").value)
            ws.Cells(i, "P").value = dt - Int(dt) 'jam saja
        Else
            ' optional: kosongkan kalau bukan jam/tanggal
            ' ws.Cells(i, "O").Value = ""
        End If
        
        
          ' === JAM: dari kolom L ke kolom O ===
        If IsDate(ws.Cells(i, "L").value) Then
            dt = CDate(ws.Cells(i, "L").value)
            ws.Cells(i, "O").value = dt - Int(dt) 'jam saja
        Else
            ' optional: kosongkan kalau bukan jam/tanggal
            ' ws.Cells(i, "O").Value = ""
        End If
    Next i
    
    
     For i = 2 To lastRow
        .Cells(i, 12).value = .Cells(i, 15).value
        .Cells(i, 13).value = .Cells(i, 16).value
        
        .Cells(i, 16).value = .Cells(i, 14).value
     Next i
     
     .Columns("N:O").ClearContents
    

    ' Format tampilan
    ws.Columns("P").NumberFormat = "dd-mmm-yyyy"
    ws.Columns("L").NumberFormat = "hh:mm:ss"
    ws.Columns("M").NumberFormat = "hh:mm:ss"
    
    
    
    
    
    With ActiveSheet.Columns("Q")

        .Replace What:=ChrW(&H591C) & ChrW(&H73ED), _
                 Replacement:="2", _
                 LookAt:=xlPart, _
                 SearchOrder:=xlByRows, _
                 MatchCase:=False

      
        .Replace What:=ChrW(&H767D) & ChrW(&H73ED), _
                 Replacement:="1", _
                 LookAt:=xlPart, _
                 SearchOrder:=xlByRows, _
                 MatchCase:=False
    End With
    
    
    .Range("A1").value = "CAT"
    .Range("D1").value = "No. DT"
    .Range("F1").value = "Customer"
    .Range("H1").value = "Tujuan"
    .Range("I1").value = "Gross"
    .Range("J1").value = "Tare"
    .Range("K1").value = "Netto"
    .Range("L1").value = "Masuk"
    .Range("M1").value = "Keluar"
    .Range("P1").value = "Tanggal"
    .Range("Q1").value = "Shift"
    
    
    End With
End Sub
